title: Product Deployment Engineer, gTech
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).
* Experience in building proof of concepts using web/scripting technologies (e.g., JavaScript, Python, etc.) and SQL databases.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* 5 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.
* 5 years of experience in operations management (i.e. process improvement, operational reviews, optimizing workflows, etc.).
* 5 years of experience in a customer-facing role.
* Understanding of advertising technologies, APIs, and data integration.
* Ability to translate complex business needs into technical specifications.

**About The Job**
As a Product Deployment Engineer within gTech Ad GCS, you will be a key advisor to Google’s customers and serve as the definitive regional service authority for a specific product area. You are the strategic bridge between “what a customer wants” and “how gTech Ads GCS can enable” within a specific product area. This role requires a deep understanding of the gTech Ads Implementation Menu of Service (MoS), strong customer engagement skills, and the ability to translate customer needs into scalable product strategies and high quality technical-product specifications that address complex business challenges.
  
  
You will bridge the gap between implementation consultancy and engineering, ensuring that Google’s gTech Ads engineering capabilities are deployed for high-impact business challenges that directly activate customer business and drive campaign performance. You are the regional authority on how technical product maturity leads to marketing outcomes.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with regional sales, product leads, and clients to evaluate technical maturity, identify custom solution opportunities, and channel field feedback back into core engineering roadmaps.
* Translate complex client requirements into scalable system architectures, robust integration strategies, and prototype-backed technical requirement documents (BRDs/PRDs).
* Codify standardized deployment playbooks and frameworks to enable scalable, vendor-executed delivery of complex workflows.
* Architect durable data pipelines and CRM integrations using the Google Ads API while ensuring full compliance with global privacy regulations.
* Oversee implementation alongside cross-functional delivery teams, stress-testing solutions with real-world validation data to guarantee reliability prior to rollout.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
****Job Details****
**Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.**
**As a Senior Technical Consultant on our Field Services team, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc..**
**You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to delivering a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background. You provide technical expertise to Field service implementation projects, evaluate the customer’s technical and functional requirements, and develop efficient solutions to help customers achieve their business goals. Within Field Service, you are a leader with vision whose voice and actions are essential in growing our overall Services business, team, and culture.**
**Senior Technical Consultants (Sr. Developers) deliver technical solutions to meet the customer’s business and technical requirements. Sr Developers lead the evaluation of options and subsequent presentation and education of the customer/partner. They will also identify and proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through to complete resolution.**
**Responsibilities**

* Become a highly certified and recognized Salesforce expert.
* Help clients consistently meet/exceed goals and metrics.
* Contribute to customer success through front and backend solution development and release management.
* Deliver high client satisfaction (CSAT).
* Provide guidance on the application and integration development best practices, functional and technical solution architecture & design, environment management, testing, and Salesforce Platform education.
* Drive the creation of application and technical design documents which leverage Salesforce best practices and effectively integrate Salesforce into the customer’s infrastructure.
* Lead the strategy for complex SFS features, including advanced Scheduling & Optimization, Maintenance Plans, and Assets with multi-level hierarchies.
* Troubleshoot key customer implementation issues and demonstrate the ability to drive to a successful resolution. Lead the evaluation of business and technical requirements from a senior level.
* Identification and proactive management of risk areas and commitment to seeing an issue through to complete resolution.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners.
* Build relationships with business partners, internal and external, and contributing to broader goals and growth beyond the scope of a single customer engagement.
* Architect data-driven solutions using Salesforce Data Cloud and Einstein to drive predictive service outcomes and automated technician insights.
* Contribute to the growth of the Services Practice by identifying and leading internal strategic initiatives to grow the consulting practice, leveraging junior teammates to achieve individual as well as team growth; serving as an active contributor to the practice knowledge and resource base; mentor, educate, and enrich technical and non-technical Salesforce customer and partner colleagues.
* Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality customer solutions.

**Requirements**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA in Computer Science Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role.
* 6-9 years of overall experience with a minimum of 3 years on the Salesforce platform.
* Highly beneficial to have any Salesforce.com product certifications prior to joining.

+ Salesforce Admin
+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ Salesforce Field Service
+ Salesforce Platform Dev1
+ Salesforce Platform Dev2
+ Agentforce Credentials

* Experience in designing & developing on Field Service implementations.
* Good experience in writing custom codes, components using APEX, LWC.
* Hands-on expertise with Field Service Mobile app customization, including LWC for Mobile and Offline-priming logic.
* Ability to work independently and be a self-starter.
* Atleast 3+ years experience as a Senior Developer in a mid to large-sized organization with demonstrated leadership driving an organizational transformation in a matrixed organization.
* Experience with key areas of enterprise architecture, including integration technologies, single sign-on, and master data management.
* Experience with modern DevOps toolchains (SFDX, GitHub, CI/CD) and sophisticated branching strategies for large-scale delivery.
* Experience with Waterfall and/or Agile implementation methodologies.
* Ability to work independently and be a self-starter. Proven results leading and overseeing customer and/or partner success stories in the following domains: front- and back-end solution architecture, development and release management strategies, change management.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Polished speaker with the ability to evangelize best practices at various levels within a large organization.
* A particular desire to continually study new technologies and functionality, as well as be involved in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies (e.g., IoT, Asset Intelligence, and Generative AI).
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* Strong presentation skills. Able to effectively present and defend a point of view to a variety of audiences.

****Location****

* Lead solutioning and discovery discussions with clients, helping them move from manual processes to advanced AI that helps them make better decisions and scale their operations.

* Build business cases and financial models that demonstrate actual financial gains and productivity improvement using our solution.

* Work directly with key customers to demonstrate existing and new AI features, with custom workflows leveraging real-time client data.
* Drive structured feedback loops to Engineering and Product teams to harden the agentic platform based on field-validated insights.

**Key Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3+ years of relevant experience in Technical Sales, Solution Selling, or Consulting within a quota-bearing environment; experience selling to the Office of the CFO is highly preferred.
* Proven track record in Enterprise SaaS and a deep aptitude for technical business conversations with both IT and finance stakeholders.
* Advanced communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to simplify complex AI concepts for executive audiences and provide technical specifications to Engineering.
* Demonstrated high agency and the ability to operate independently in high-stakes environments/ Proactively navigated high-pressure scenarios to deliver results with minimal oversight
* Adequate technical knowledge of AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) is a distinct advantage.
* Strong domain expertise in Finance (CFO office), with a solid understanding of ERP systems and Order-to-Cash processes.
* Experience in technical consulting or pre-sales, with a knack for building ROI models.
* MBA preferred; Bachelor's degree with significant relevant work experience (3+ years) will be considered. Knowledge of Accounts Receivable and Order-to-Cash processes is a distinct advantage.

* Competitive salary.
* Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)

description:
**Meet the Team**
As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you are passionate about customers and will fuel solutions to ensure every customer request makes the deepest impact possible for our customers and share the best-of-the-best with the team. You will be a Splunk expert and adept at understanding, adapting, and guiding our account teams and customers on how to best use our Platform.
  
  
**Your impact**
**Responsibilities**

* Skilled and aligned to Splunk Security license products, such as Enterprise Security (ES), security applications like Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA), and/or SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response)
* Highly skilled and aligned to Splunk’s Core licensed product, such as Enterprise and Cloud.
* Strategically support the Customer Success Executive, Technical Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Solution Architect motions.
* Develop strong partnership with Sales/Customer Success roles to assist Area aligned customers with Value Realization. Activities include, but not limited to:

+ Onboarding & Enablement – deliver workshops, prescriptive guidance/assistance, achieve onboarding milestones
+ Health Review & Remediation
+ Security Use Case Activation
+ Proactively engaging Technical Success Engineers to review and assess their account’s health situation, with an emphasis on accounts that have telemetry risk signals and/or 6 months from renewal date.
+ Proactively engaging Customer Success Executives on adoption/use case-related work opportunity.
+ Proactively engage CS/SE Management to ensure priority focus alignment and address risk accounts themes.
+ Strategic case-based delivery, up to 90 days of assistance, which is requested by internal Area aligned account teams or management. This typically involves providing customers with high-quality technical advice on Enterprise level architecture, implementation, configuration and optimization work in complex environments for Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR.

**As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you will**

* Be passionate about customers and deliver impactful solutions.
* Address organizations’ complex technical challenges, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer.
* Be a self-motivated Splunk expert eager to learn and adapt in a multifaceted environment.
* Guide account team members and customers on optimal use of Splunk Platform and Splunk Enterprise Security. Provide recommendations for a customer’s overall technical health.
* Deliver strategic, case-based technical consulting (up to 90 days).
* Collaborate with internal resources and customer-facing teams to manage customer needs.
* Conduct research from various resources with the ability to consistently find answers to questions and solve complex technical problems.
* Execute consultative conversations with decision makers to diagnose and establish the potential value of solving business issues, change or expand existing solution requirements based on your discovery/assessment, and provide broader based recommendations to help customers accelerate their product initiatives, optimize cost, and maximize performance.
* Gain agreement with account team members and customer decision-makers on the tangible value of proposed solutions.
* Deliver customer onboarding enablement-based workshops and achieve success milestones.
* Contribute to practice KPIs through process and collateral improvements, tool development, and implementation.

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Deep technical knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) configuration, administration, and development, including expertise in Assets and Identities, Threat Intelligence, Notable Events, Adaptive Response, and Risk-based Analytics.
* Data Management: Experience with integrating and normalising data from diverse sources. Understanding of the Common Information Model (CIM) and experience with data onboarding, including forwarding architecture and technical add-ons.
* Strong command of Search Processing Language (SPL); experience developing and optimizing correlation and risk-based alerting rules.
* Strong Splunk architecture, data onboarding, and Splunk Core product feature experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cybersecurity Domain: Solid foundation in security operations, forensics, threat hunting, insider threats, and compliance.
* Cybersecurity Frameworks: Solid foundation in NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS
* Industry Standard Security Certifications: GIAC, CISSP, OSCP or equivalent
* Infrastructure: Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Splunk Certifications/Accreditations: ES Implementation Accreditation and/or SOAR consultant I & II
* Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments
* Statistical and analytical modeling skills are a plus.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (bash), application development (Java, Python, .NET), databases, and analytical tools.
* Hands-on experience with Splunk product implementation of focus and Splunk Cloud.
* Experience with cloud migration projects.
* Solid experience in technical consulting or big-data analytics.

**Soft Skills-**

* Trusted technical advisor with the ability to lead assigned tickets and priorities. Engages in “out of the box” thinking to resolve problems
* Relationship Management - Establish technical credibility with a wide range of internal and customer contacts with the ability to “read” the internal/customer contact and adapt behavior / approach
* Conflict Resolution - Ability to engage in escalation management
* Influencing/Negotiating - Ability to influence peers, Splunk leadership and customers. Ability to handle highly complex/distributed IT environments and/or accounts that demand a high level of negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
* Problem/Need Identification - Demonstrates a deep comprehension of the customers, account team and/or customer’s business strategy, business objectives & challenges, success criteria/how customer measures success, and training needs. Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
* Mentor/Team Player - Possesses ability to take on mentorship roles as identified by management team. Identifies, defines, and leads Priorities to Improve to help team reach its goals
* Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Active listening and objective consideration of others’ opinions.
* Strong customer-facing skills to instill confidence and guide towards resolution.
* Ability to balance multiple account teams, customers and challenging priorities effectively.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Client Engagement & Success Manager
description:
**About Arise Tech Global**

Arise Tech Global is a technology and talent solutions company helping organizations build high-performing teams across cybersecurity, enterprise technology, cloud, and digital transformation.

**About the Role**

**Client Engagement & Success Manager**

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office (WFO)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an
**exceptional, product-oriented Senior Client Engagement & Success Manager**
to lead post-sales strategy and outcomes for an enterprise
**Threat Detection & Response**
portfolio.

The role involves acting as a trusted advisor to mid-to-large enterprise security leaders, driving security ROI and value realization, managing account governance, increasing platform adoption across
**SIEM, SOAR, and cloud-native EDR/XDR environments**
, identifying growth opportunities, and representing the Voice of the Customer to Product and Engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Governance & Executive Alignment**

* Lead high-impact
  **Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)**
  and
  **Monthly Service Reviews (MSRs)**
  with CISOs, CIOs, and SecOps leaders.
* Demonstrate tangible
  **risk reduction, security outcomes, and program value**
  to executive stakeholders.
* Build strong, long-term relationships across multiple customer personas, from
  **SOC Analysts to CISOs and senior security leadership**
  .

**Value Realization & Technical Account Governance**

* Govern technical account operations and track incremental improvements to ensure committed security outcomes are delivered.
* Drive adoption of the security platform across
  **SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and cloud-native security environments**
  .
* Partner with client security teams to understand their evolving architecture and threat landscape.
* Coordinate with operations and engineering teams to address
  **security posture gaps**
  across the Threat Detection & Response layer.

**Account Growth & Revenue Retention**

* Monitor account health metrics and identify
  **white-space opportunities**
  for account expansion.
* Partner with sales teams to execute
  **upsell and cross-sell strategies**
  .
* Proactively identify churn indicators and develop turnaround plans for at-risk accounts.
* Manage complex technical escalations and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

**Product Voice & Client Advocacy**

* Capture and synthesize
  **customer feedback, operational pain points, and feature requests**
  .
* Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations for
  **Product and Engineering teams**
  .
* Build strong client advocacy by converting successful outcomes into
  **case studies, customer references, advocacy groups, and advisory board participation**
  .

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience in
  **Client Success, Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Client Engagement**
  within enterprise technology or cybersecurity environments.
* Strong understanding of
  **Threat Detection & Response**
  and enterprise security operations.
* Experience working with security platforms and environments such as
  **SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and cloud security**
  .
* Strong ability to engage with
  **CISOs, CIOs, SecOps leaders, SOC teams, and technical stakeholders**
  .
* Experience managing enterprise accounts and driving
  **value realization, adoption, retention, and account growth**
  .
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand technical security challenges and translate them into
  **business outcomes and actionable plans**
  .
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage
  **technical escalations and at-risk accounts**
  .
* Product-oriented mindset with the ability to effectively communicate the
  **Voice of the Customer**
  to internal Product and Engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with
  **enterprise cybersecurity products or managed security services**
  .
* Exposure to
  **SIEM, SOAR, MDR/XDR, cloud-native security, and threat detection platforms**
  .
* Experience conducting
  **QBRs, MSRs, executive reviews, and technical account governance**
  .
* Experience driving customer advocacy, references, case studies, and advisory programs.
* Experience working with mid-to-large enterprise customers.

title: AVP Global Client Partner
description:
**Leading at Cognizant**
This is a leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future, live the leadership behaviors, uphold our Values, and nurture our people and culture to create a workplace where all can thrive.
  
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As AVP Client Partner, you will make an impact by developing and executing account strategy, driving sustainable revenue growth, managing P&L performance, and strengthening executive client relationships. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences account leadership team and work collaboratively with Markets, client relationship managers, sales, pre-sales, service lines, alliance partners, and client stakeholders.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Define and execute the account strategy and plan, aligning customer outcomes with a clear vision for growth across the Novartis account.
* Own P&L performance and drive revenue growth in line with or above the market, while identifying and addressing account-level challenges.
* Co-own offering positioning for India and DACH Life Sciences accounts by identifying portfolio gaps, shaping offering strategy and roadmaps, and managing opportunities from ideation through sales closure.
* Lead sales and account-penetration activities by translating business problems into technology-enabled solutions, qualifying opportunities, and partnering with client relationship managers and sales teams.
* Direct deal pursuits end to end within the service line, ensuring effective pre-sales engagement through workshops, digital dialogues, demonstrations, and proofs of concept, and personally engaging priority clients to credentialize deals.
* Shape thought leadership and portfolio strategy, engage external analysts, and drive market education and commercial conversations.
* Own strategic alliance and vendor relationships, developing partnerships that improve business outcomes and support sell-with growth.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead through Personal Leadership, Organizational Leadership, and Business Leadership, including building trust and inclusion, setting bold strategic direction, maintaining client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability, and operating with financial acumen.

**Measures of success**

* TCV growth and revenue growth, including relative growth compared with leading competitors.
* Portfolio mix and revenue mix across service lines.
* Client deployments of intellectual property, accelerators, and solutions.
* Partnership growth, including sell-with TCV.
* Improvement in average billing rates.
* Diversity and inclusive leadership outcomes.
* Effective ownership of strategic-priority socialization, new portfolio development within existing logos, deal pursuits, sales strategy, account planning, growth priorities, and differentiated solution design.

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* A minimum of 10 years of experience in a senior leadership role.
* A minimum of 15 years of complex solutioning experience, supported by broad technical experience.
* A minimum of 15 years of experience in the assigned functional or technology area, with applicable market-standard certifications.
* Demonstrated capability in account strategy, account planning, sales strategy, P&L management, revenue growth, and end-to-end deal pursuits.
* Experience translating business challenges into technology-enabled solutions and engaging senior client stakeholders in commercial and solution conversations.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, and Leading the Business.
* Embodiment of Cognizant Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

**These will help you succeed**

* Senior leadership experience managing a large portfolio and working with large, globally distributed teams.
* Domain expertise across verticals, with the ability to apply industry, geography, and practice-area insight to client priorities.
* A track record of bringing products and offerings to market and leveraging organizational capabilities to support differentiated offers and solutions.
* Experience developing strategic alliances, engaging external analysts, and shaping thought leadership and portfolio strategy.
* Strong executive presence, commercial judgment, and the ability to build trust across client, sales, pre-sales, service-line, and partner stakeholders.

**Work model**
The working arrangement for this role will be based on business and client requirements and will be communicated during the hiring process. Working arrangements may change based on the project, business, and client requirements. We will always be clear about role expectations and support a healthy work-life balance through our wellbeing programs.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Consider the transferable experiences and unique skills that enable you to bring new and valuable perspectives to this role

title: Tech Process Senior Specialist - Customer Support (Orion) - PMAX
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Product Consultant, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support [across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
  
  
In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Technical Product Consultant will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****Position Responsibilities**
**:****

* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root-cause analysis to implement long-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end-to-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.
* Engineering Liaison & Bug Management: Own the end-to-end bug reporting lifecycle. Translate complex, ambiguous technical failures into high-quality bug reports for Engineering, ensuring all technical requirements, reproduction steps, and impact assessments are clearly communicated to drive faster resolution.
* Knowledge Architecture: Partner with Product Enablement Team and Center of Excellence team to co-create, update, and audit troubleshooting content and documentation for current products and new Beta releases.
* Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, and CoEs to provide strategic feedback based on support trends. Lead deep-dive root cause analysis to advocate for product and process improvements.
* Ecosystem Empowerment: Develop and deliver formal training, "Train-the-Trainer" (TTT) sessions, and certification programs to build a pipeline of product experts across GOC L1 and partner teams.
* AI & Innovation: Manage Agent Assist pilots for relevant new product launches and validate AI-generated support outputs. Model domain knowledge to improve automated support tools and test outputs for upcoming product features.
* Data-Driven Insights: Analyze complex datasets to identify systemic issues and performance trends. Translate these insights into actionable business recommendations to enhance the customer journey.
* Inclusive Leadership: Drive a culture of mentorship. Guide frontline SMEs on product nuances and foster a collaborative, globally dispersed team environment.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in project/program management, technical consulting, or a client-facing role.
* 4+ years of experience specifically within the Ads Product ecosystem
* Experience in end-to-end Campaign Operations and Performance Diagnostics, including media planning, traffic analysis, and real-time optimization. Must have a proven track record of performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex delivery issues and translating technical troubleshooting into customer-centric solutions.
* Strong written and oral communication and experiencing interfacing with Engineering and Product teams
* Experience in content development or knowledge management; with a focus on translating internal product specifications into actionable support content and instructional materials for iterative product releases.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation (e.g., SQL, PLX).
* Ability to pivot expertise across different Google Ads products [Search, Video, Display, Mobile, Commerce et] Platform analytics and tools.
* Proven track record of navigating interdependent processes and making decisions that prioritize the customer in ambiguous situations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and competing priorities under tight deadlines.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

title: Junior Academic Counsellor
description:
Student Tribe is a growing platform focused on bridging the gap between
**education and career opportunities**
. We offer IT and non-IT courses that help students build industry-relevant skills and move closer to their career goals.

About the Role

We’re looking for a
**Business Development & Sales Executive**
with prior experience in
**EdTech sales, business development, or student counselling**
.

You’ll be responsible for connecting with prospective students, understanding their career goals, guiding them towards the right programs, and driving course enrollments.

If you enjoy talking to people, working towards targets, and turning conversations into meaningful outcomes, this role could be a great fit.

What You’ll Do

* Connect with prospective students through
  **calls, WhatsApp, emails, and meetings**
* Understand students’ career goals, interests, and learning requirements
* Counsel students and recommend relevant IT and non-IT programs
* Manage and actively follow up with leads provided by the company
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline
* Convert qualified leads into successful course enrollments
* Achieve monthly and quarterly
  **sales and enrollment targets**
* Maintain accurate lead and interaction records in the CRM
* Work closely with the
  **Marketing and Operations teams**
  to improve lead quality and conversions
* Represent Student Tribe at
  **events, webinars, workshops, and student outreach initiatives**

What We’re Looking For

* **6 months – 1 year of experience**
  in EdTech sales, business development, inside sales, or student counselling
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Good interpersonal and counselling skills
* Ability to build rapport with
  **students and parents**
* Comfortable working with sales targets and follow-ups
* Strong negotiation and conversion skills
* Self-driven, proactive, and results-oriented
* Familiarity with
  **CRM and lead management tools**
  is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline

What You’ll Get

* Competitive salary +
  **performance-based incentives**
* Opportunity to work in a fast-growing
  **EdTech environment**
* Hands-on exposure to sales, student counselling, and business development
* Learning and professional development opportunities
* A collaborative and energetic work environment

Think you’re a good fit?

If you’re someone who can
**communicate well, build relationships, own your targets, and turn opportunities into results**
, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and join Student Tribe!**

title: Package Consultant-Workday HCM & Compensation
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in Workday HCM and Compensation, you will apply consulting skills, business knowledge, and packaged solution expertise to configure the system to meet the client's business needs. You will play a key role in implementing and supporting the Workday core HCM and core compensation modules for clients.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Implement Core Modules: Configure the Workday core HCM and core compensation modules to meet the client's business needs, ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
* Conduct Fit Analysis: Gather requirements, perform fit analysis, and plan the implementation to ensure the system meets the client's business objectives.
* Resolve Configuration Issues: Identify and resolve configuration and functional issues across various core HCM and core compensation modules, providing timely and effective solutions.
* Deliver Post-Implementation Support: Provide ongoing support after implementation, addressing client queries and concerns, and making necessary adjustments to ensure continued system effectiveness.
* Perform Unit Testing: Conduct thorough unit testing to ensure the configured system meets the client's requirements and is free from defects.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Workday HCM: Familiarity with configuring and implementing Workday core HCM modules, including setup and integration with other modules.
* Core Compensation Knowledge: Understanding of core compensation concepts and practices, with experience in configuring and supporting Workday core compensation modules.
* Implementation Planning: Experience with planning and conducting fit analysis to ensure seamless implementation of Workday core HCM and core compensation modules.
* Configuration and Troubleshooting: Exposure to identifying and resolving configuration and functional issues across various core HCM and core compensation modules.
* Unit Testing and Quality Assurance: Familiarity with conducting unit testing to ensure configured systems meet client requirements and are free from defects.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Workday Reporting Skills: Exposure to creating and customizing reports in Workday, including report writing and data analysis, to support client business needs.
* Cloud-Based Solutions: Familiarity with cloud-based HCM and compensation solutions, with an understanding of their integration and implementation.

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to align on deliverables, timelines, ownership, dependencies, risks, and open actions.
* Prepare meeting materials, presentation packs, communication notes, training content, and status updates.
* Drive follow-through on project milestones, risk mitigation actions, issue resolution, and stakeholder commitments.
* Operate independently and as part of a team to complete assigned tasks with high quality and within agreed timelines.

Continuous Improvement & Governance
  
  

* Identify opportunities to standardize sourcing support, spend reporting, contract tracking, and stakeholder engagement processes.
* Support development of SOPs, playbooks, templates, governance routines, and reporting standards.
* Track operational metrics such as RFx cycle time, spend analytics turnaround time, contract expiration visibility, stakeholder requests, and reporting accuracy.

* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across Indirect Sourcing and the Global Procurement CoE.

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 6-10 years of experience in an international procurement organization, preferably supporting indirect procurement or global sourcing teams.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in sourcing support, contract lifecycle management, spend analysis, procurement operations, or category management support.
* Experience supporting RFQ, RFP, and RFI processes, including market research, benchmarking, supplier analysis, bid evaluation, and documentation.
* Strong analytical skills with proven comfort in spend analysis, lifecycle analysis, ROI evaluation, and policy compliance assessment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint with ability to prepare executive-ready analysis, reports, and presentations.
* Ability to independently and collaboratively complete assigned tasks with excellent results while meeting agreed deadlines.
* Ability to make decisions and drive task completion in situations where absolute clarity does not exist.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with digital procurement tools such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Fairmarkit, or similar sourcing, spend intelligence, and contract management platforms.

title: Oracle EPM Allocations Lead
description:
**Enterprise Functions Engineering**
Enterprise Functions Engineering drives the strategy, delivery, and support of LSEG's enterprise platforms across Finance, Risk and other corporate functions. Our mission is to simplify and standardise business processes, accelerate digital transformation, and enable data-driven decision-making through innovative technology solutions.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As an Oracle EPM EPCM Specialist, you will contribute to the design, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, with a focus on Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management (EPCM). Working closely with Enterprise Functions stakeholders and Engineering teams, you will help deliver scalable profitability and cost allocation solutions that support strategic decision-making across the organisation.
  
  
This role is ideal for professionals passionate about solving complex business challenges, improve transparency in financial performance, and drive continuous process improvement.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

* Proven experience as a Manager or Lead Consultant, Senior Consultant, or Solution Architect with hands-on implementation and support of Oracle EPM Cloud solutions, specifically EPCM.
* Strong understanding of profitability modelling, cost allocation methodologies, managerial accounting, and driver-based planning and allocations.
* Experience designing and implementing complex allocation frameworks and profitability models within large enterprise environments.
* Deep understanding of Finance transformation initiatives and Enterprise Performance Management best practices.
* Experience integrating Oracle EPM with ERP, data warehouses, and reporting platforms.
* Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively within a wider delivery team.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication capabilities.

**Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities**

* Own and prioritise business requirements related to Oracle EPCM and associated EPM applications.
* Partner with Finance and Corporate Function stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document detailed business requirements.
* Design and configure profitability and cost allocation models that support business planning and performance management objectives.
* Build and maintain rule sets, drivers, calculations, metadata structures, allocations, and reporting solutions within Oracle EPCM.
* Analyse business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, transparency, and decision-making through technology.
* Support enterprise planning transformation initiatives through process standardisation and automation.
* Evaluate Oracle monthly releases and implement enhancements where appropriate.
* Plan, test, and deploy solution enhancements while ensuring alignment with governance and control requirements.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Engineering, Data, Test, Change, and Operations teams to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Finance and Enterprise Function stakeholders on EPM best practices and optimisation opportunities.
* Stay current with Oracle EPM roadmap developments, industry trends, and emerging technologies.

**Key Relationships**
To successfully deliver technology solutions, it is essential to partner closely with Finance, Finance Transformation teams, process owners, wider Engineering teams, Technology Delivery, External implementation and consulting partners where applicable. This collaboration ensures alignment across strategic priorities, operating models, governance requirements, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Essential Skills**
**Technical / Professional Skills & Competencies**

* 7+ years of experience implementing or supporting Oracle EPM Cloud solutions.
* Deep expertise in Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management (EPCM).
* Strong knowledge of Financial Planning, Cost Management, Management Reporting, and Enterprise Performance Management processes.
* Experience designing and deploying complex profitability and allocation models.
* Experience with Calculation Manager - Groovy, metadata management, reporting and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of Oracle EPM architecture and integration patterns.
* Experience working with Oracle ERP Cloud, Oracle Fusion Applications, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
* Strong SQL, data analysis, and reconciliation capabilities.
* Ability to communicate technical solutions effectively to both technical and business audiences.
* Strong project delivery, prioritisation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, testing, deployment, and support.

**Desired Skills**

title: Wealth Hub Client Services & Technical Delivery, AVP
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
The AVP, Client Services & Technical Delivery will be responsible for client onboarding, technical integrations, platform operations, API enablement, file feed management, Corporate Actions governance and automation, Security Master operations, and operational support for the Wealth Hub platform.
  
  
This role serves as the primary liaison between clients, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Data Operations, and SaaS Operations teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, operational stability, and ongoing support of Wealth Hub services.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong client-facing skills with deep technical expertise in APIs, enterprise integrations, file feed onboarding and management, cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, operational automation, investment operations, Corporate Actions governance and automation, Security Master management, and enterprise SaaS platform delivery. The candidate should be equally comfortable engaging with business stakeholders, operations teams, developers, architects, and client technology organizations.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important to Us**
Wealth Hub is a strategic platform supporting wealth managers, sponsors, asset managers, custodians, and model providers through secure, scalable, and highly integrated technology solutions.
  
  
This role is critical to ensuring successful client implementations, operational readiness, data integrity, platform stability, Corporate Actions processing, Security Master governance, integration reliability, and continuous automation initiatives that support future growth and scalability.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As
**AVP, Client Services & Technical Delivery**
, you will:
  
  
**Client Services & Delivery**

* Coordinate client onboarding, implementation, and integration projects.
* Serve as the primary technical contact for strategic clients.
* Manage client escalations and drive issues through resolution.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, technical workshops, and API demonstrations.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Operations teams to ensure successful client outcomes.
* Coordinate onboarding of sponsors, asset managers, wealth managers, custodians, and third-party providers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on operational workflows, integrations, and platform capabilities.

**API & Integration Management**

* Lead API onboarding and integration initiatives.
* Develop, test, troubleshoot, and demonstrate APIs end-to-end.
* Create sample code, payloads, technical documentation, and testing artifacts.
* Partner directly with client development teams during implementation and support.
* Troubleshoot authentication, connectivity, data validation, and integration issues.
* Support REST APIs, web services, event-based integrations, and secure connectivity solutions.
* Assist clients with API troubleshooting, onboarding, testing, and adoption.

**Data Integration & File Feed Management**

* Lead support of inbound and outbound file-based integrations.
* Manage connectivity with sponsors, asset managers, custodians, wealth managers, market data vendors, and external service providers.
* Define file specifications, mapping requirements, transformation rules, and validation controls.
* Support integration technologies including SFTP, FTPS, APIs, message-based interfaces, and cloud-based data exchanges.
* Troubleshoot file delivery failures, processing exceptions, transformation issues, and reconciliation breaks.
* Coordinate testing and implementation of new client and vendor data feeds.
* Design automated monitoring, alerting, and recovery processes for critical file feeds.
* Establish operational controls and service level monitoring across integration workflows.
* Develop operational reporting and dashboards to measure feed health, reliability, and performance.

**Platform Operations & Software Delivery**

* Coordinate software releases, patches, hotfixes, and production deployments.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release validation.
* Drive troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex production issues.
* Ensure that data, overnight processing, and platform services are validated and available for client use by 7:00 AM ET.
* Drive operational automation initiatives using scripting, workflow orchestration, and DevOps tooling.
* Maintain operational procedures, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Participate in disaster recovery exercises and resiliency testing initiatives.

**Corporate Actions & Security Master Governance**

* Drive Corporate Actions automation initiatives to reduce manual intervention, operational risk, and processing exceptions.
* Manage Corporate Actions (CA) operations across the Wealth Hub platform.
* Monitor daily Corporate Actions activity and ensure timely processing and issue resolution.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Corporate Actions-related incidents, escalations, and client inquiries.
* Maintain Security Master integrity through ongoing monitoring, reconciliation, and data quality controls.
* Coordinate with internal and external data providers to resolve security reference data issues.
* Implement controls and operational processes to support data accuracy and platform resiliency.

**Security & Cloud Operations**

* Support certificate management, mTLS connectivity, encryption, and secure integrations.
* Partner with Infrastructure teams on Azure platform services and operational improvements.
* Support Azure Key Vault integration and secrets management best practices.

**What We Value**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms within financial services or other regulated industries.
* Deep expertise in Corporate Actions operations, lifecycle event processing, automation, exception management, and governance controls.
* Subject matter expertise in APIs, secure integrations, mTLS authentication, certificate management, SFTP connectivity, and enterprise data exchange frameworks.
* Strong understanding of Security Master governance, reference data management, reconciliation processes, and data quality controls.
* Strong client-facing skills and experience engaging with external stakeholders.

**Preferred Technical Expertise**

* REST APIs, JSON, and OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.
* API onboarding, testing, troubleshooting, and client integration support.
* OAuth2, TLS/mTLS, certificates, and secure connectivity frameworks.
* SFTP, file feed onboarding, data exchange workflows, and vendor integrations.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write and troubleshoot complex queries, perform data analysis, validate production issues, and reconcile operational data.
* Charles River IMS, Wealth Hub, wealth management, or investment operations experience preferred.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
* 13+ years of experience in Platform Operations, SaaS Delivery, Client Implementations, DevOps, Technical Product Management, Investment Operations, or Software Engineering.
* Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms and client-facing technical solutions.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Tech Process Senior Specialist - Customer Support (Orion) - Apps
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Product Consultant, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support [across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
  
  
In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Technical Product Consultant will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****Position Responsibilities**
**:****

* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root-cause analysis to implement long-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end-to-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.
* Engineering Liaison & Bug Management: Own the end-to-end bug reporting lifecycle. Translate complex, ambiguous technical failures into high-quality bug reports for Engineering, ensuring all technical requirements, reproduction steps, and impact assessments are clearly communicated to drive faster resolution.
* Knowledge Architecture: Partner with Product Enablement Team and Center of Excellence team to co-create, update, and audit troubleshooting content and documentation for current products and new Beta releases.
* Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, and CoEs to provide strategic feedback based on support trends. Lead deep-dive root cause analysis to advocate for product and process improvements.
* Ecosystem Empowerment: Develop and deliver formal training, "Train-the-Trainer" (TTT) sessions, and certification programs to build a pipeline of product experts across GOC L1 and partner teams.
* AI & Innovation: Manage Agent Assist pilots for relevant new product launches and validate AI-generated support outputs. Model domain knowledge to improve automated support tools and test outputs for upcoming product features.
* Data-Driven Insights: Analyze complex datasets to identify systemic issues and performance trends. Translate these insights into actionable business recommendations to enhance the customer journey.
* Inclusive Leadership: Drive a culture of mentorship. Guide frontline SMEs on product nuances and foster a collaborative, globally dispersed team environment.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in project/program management, technical consulting, or a client-facing role.
* 4+ years of experience specifically within the Ads Product ecosystem
* Experience in end-to-end Campaign Operations and Performance Diagnostics, including media planning, traffic analysis, and real-time optimization. Must have a proven track record of performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex delivery issues and translating technical troubleshooting into customer-centric solutions.
* Strong written and oral communication and experiencing interfacing with Engineering and Product teams
* Experience in content development or knowledge management; with a focus on translating internal product specifications into actionable support content and instructional materials for iterative product releases.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation (e.g., SQL, PLX).
* Ability to pivot expertise across different Google Ads products [Search, Video, Display, Mobile, Commerce et] Platform analytics and tools.
* Proven track record of navigating interdependent processes and making decisions that prioritize the customer in ambiguous situations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and competing priorities under tight deadlines.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

title: Senior Manager, Solutions Consulting India
description:
**Meet Our Team**
As Sr. Manager to Solutions Consulting team for India, you will lead a team of Solutions Consultants covering Pega’s Global Clients and / or Partners and their clients with presence in India. You will also collaborate cross-functionally with sales leadership, solution consulting leadership, account executives, consulting, partners, business officers, and other stakeholders to define and execute on the sales strategy, secure revenue targets and drive adoption of Pega AI Blueprint and Pega's AI-powered workflow and decisioning capabilities. The team is customer-centric, technical, business/value outcome driven, and focused on transforming clients through Pega's solutions. This is a player / coach role where you will work on an account alongside providing guidance to the team.
  
  
**Picture Yourself At Pega**
This must be one of the most exciting roles in the industry. You will lead a top performing and highly talented team and work with award winning solutions. Pega’s Customers are transforming with speed, Pega's tools and solutions are right there to help them.
  
  
You play a critical role driving Pega's strategy using Pega AI Blueprint and Predictable AI. Blueprint changes the way we interact and work with our customers dramatically, reducing time it takes to drive customers' outcomes and value. As the Solutions Consulting leader, you're at the forefront of this change, being a true Blueprint advocate and leader. This role provides a great opportunity to build on the foundations of the team through introducing the Solution Designer approach, turning customer ideas/needs into solutions in weeks.
  
  
Reporting to the Director Solution Consulting and DemoX, you are the technical representative at executive level. being a partner for our most strategic customers. You're an energetic team player with a passion for driving value for customers, who will act as a thought leader, and represent Pega's core technology to the outside world. Your vision, ambition, and leadership will be critical as we continue to grow our revenue and rapidly expand our presence in 2026 and beyond.
  
  
At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
  
  
We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do At Pega**
**Technical Sales Strategy and Execution**

* Use Pega AI Blueprint and Predictable AI to help our customers across Financial Services, Insurance, Communications, Healthcare and Manufacturing to drive outcomes, innovate, reduce costs and modernize their legacy estate.
* As a Player / Coach, lead the team in Qualification, Solution Design and development of best practice technical solutions that leverage Pega's solutions.
* Proactively support and work with the Solutions Consulting and Sales teams in Designing Solutions, present and demonstrate and share best practice to "raise the bar".
* Engage and develop relationships with client and partner executives acting as a counterpart for our most strategic CIO’s/CTO’s.
* Be a recognized thought leader and domain expert in Pega solutions, representing Pega to the outside world and at events
* Lead the team with the Solution Design approach.
* You will play a player / coach role where you will work on an account alongside providing guidance to the team.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead the team in execution of Pega Sales strategy with focus on Blueprint and the Solution Designer approach.
* Secure execution and compliance with Solutions Consulting tasks and goals (Spending time with and at our customers, Blueprint adoption, Training and use of Pega's sales automation system).
* Drive and support the innovation and adoption of initiatives, reusable assets, selling programs, enablement, to scale the success of Pega's core technologies.
* Collaborate and foster strong partnerships with internal leaders in Specialists, Product Development, Product Marketing, Alliances, Industry Business Units, and other peer Specialist organizations globally at Pega.

**People Development**

* Lead the team towards the best Solution Designers in the industry.
* Cultivate your team of direct reports through coaching, goal-setting, and performance management, with a focus on developing expertise in their chosen domain or the client they support
* Develop and maintain cutting-edge Solutions Consultant knowledge of Pega AI Blueprint, Pega Platform, GenAI capabilities, and other core Pega technologies in partnership with the Product teams.

Oversee the Solutions Consultants to ensure accurate planning and coordination of all requests for resources from the sales field to ensure a balanced workload across the team.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* An ambitious leader, coach and someone who will roll up sleeves to work on their own account with an understanding and background in one or more of the following domains - Financial Services, Insurance, Communications, Healthcare and Manufacturing
* Passionate about people, Pega AI Blueprint, technology, and the transformative potential of workflow and Predictable AI.
* Enjoy being hands-on in the field, coaching and leading by example to secure results on critical engagements with enterprise clients.
* You're a strategic thinker with experience and excitement for managing a driven, successful Solutions Consulting team focused on helping the account team achieve their Revenue goals
* You proactively develop relationships with prospects by understanding, anticipating and showcasing AI-powered solutions that meet the unique business needs customers in these fields
* Willing to travel throughout the region to support the business.
* You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**What You've Accomplished**

* Demonstrated leadership and initiative to build scale, and driven growth.
* Experience advising and managing a team of Solutions Consultants with a focus driving adoption and evangelization and consulting on proof solutions to help sell an enterprise grade SaaS product
* 6+ years managing pre-sales teams with a successful track record working with enterprise clients through enterprise-like sales engagements in any of the following domains: Financial Services, insurance, Telecom, Healthcare, Manufacturing
* 6+ years of working as an independent solutions consultant in a presales team
* Deep technical acumen with strong preference for CRM, BPM, and AI experience
* Delivered POCs and custom demonstrations that showcase how Pega's AI capabilities solve specific challenges in any of the domains listed above
* Provided thought leadership in technology with an emphasis on how AI is transforming customer operations in Financial Services

**Pega Offers You**

* A fun and dynamic work environment in which you will have an amazing opportunity to make a big impact.
* Gartner/Forester Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products including Pega Platform, Customer Decision Hub, and Intelligent Automation.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities in core Pega technologies and AI-driven solutions.
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, and structured work environment.
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

title: Digital Transformation Consultant - Higher Education
description:
Every campus in India is about to be reimagined by AI. We're looking for the person who starts that conversation. Digital transformation doesn't begin with software. It begins with someone the Institution trusts.

  
Campx is an AI-native campus operating system for Indian higher education. Live in 7 states, Campx is used every day by more than 150 institutions, 5,00,000 students and 30,000 faculty, and our AI layer, Medha, powers smarter decisions across admissions, academics, examinations and administration.
  
As a Digital Transformation Consultant, you will be Campx's gateway in your region. You'll build trusted relationships with institutional leadership and lead them into the next chapter of how campuses run. If you're the person colleges call before they make a big decision, keep reading.
  
  
Regions
  
- Rajasthan
  
- Gujarat
  
- Maharashtra
  
- Madhya Pradesh
  
- Karnataka
  
- Tamil Nadu
  
- Uttar Pradesh
  
- West Bengal (Kolkata)
  
  
What You'll Do
  
- Represent Campx in your region and act as our first point of contact with institutions
  
- Identify and engage key decision makers, including Chairpersons, Secretaries, Principals, Directors and Registrars (the people who actually say yes)
  
- Understand each institution's structure, challenges and ambitions through on-ground meetings
  
- Organise workshops with leadership teams to show what an AI-powered campus can look like
  
- Build long-term relationships, then hand over to our solutions team to take things forward
  
- Share regular market insights and pipeline updates with the Campx leadership team
  
  
What You Bring
  
- 2+ years in higher education, EdTech, institutional sales or B2B relationship management
  
- A strong network among college and university management in your region
  
- Proven sales skills, with the ability to win trust before you win a deal
  
- Hands-on experience with AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for research, pitch preparation and follow-ups (we'll know if you've only read about them)
  
- A good understanding of the Indian higher education ecosystem, including affiliations, NAAC, NBA and NEP
  
- Fluency in English and the regional language(s) of your territory
  
- A preference for campus visits over cubicles
  
- Hands-on experience with CRM tools such as Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar for managing leads and pipelines
  
Why Campx
  
- A flexible consulting role with attractive, performance-linked incentives
  
- The chance to represent one of India's fastest-growing campus technology companies
  
- A front-row seat as AI changes how Indian institutions operate
  
  
We already hold a 50% market share in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Now we're taking that momentum across India, and we need the right people on the ground to lead the way.
  
  
How to Apply
  
Apply through LinkedIn and mention the region you'd like to cover. Bonus points if you tell us, in two lines, about a relationship that opened a door no one else could.
