title: Senior Pricing Analyst (Asia Pacific)-3
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Senior Pricing Analyst is an advanced subject matter expert, accountable for supporting growth across deals and analyzing deals to find efficiencies and ensure lower costs and maximum profitability.
  
  
This role consults on pre-sales engagements to support the qualification of deals with a particular focus on the pricing and margin aspects of the pursuit.
  
  
The Senior Pricing Analyst consults on any complex deal review process related to deals in their assigned area of responsibility.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Provide an analytical breakdown of pricing structures.
* Responsible for maintaining familiarity with hardware / software licensing and services commercial model in the vendor’s environment.
* Accountable for costing optimization with the vendors and regions and network with the Sales team to optimize deals, mitigate risks for the organization and prevent potential channel or country/region conflicts.
* Works across multiple teams to implement pricing and deal packaging guidelines.
* Directs the analysis of data from a variety of sources and using it to derive insights into pricing strategies and market trends.
* Creates competitive pricing proposition of specific client deals.
* Accountable for achieving an appropriate commercial return and manage key risks – network with multiple teams and facilitate deal reviews and approvals by Sales and Finance by managing the communication and structuring of business opportunities.
* Accountable for ensuring that the pricing design includes development of the client business case, the company business case, a pricing response, contractual pricing documents, addressing client concerns/requirements and mitigating business risks.
* Accountable for deal structuring and/or packaging guidance to Sales, incorporating macro perspective into deal guidance in order to ensure that deals make overall business sense (precedent setting, pricing/discounts across segments/geographies and product family, hardware and software discounts).
* Creates pricing tools that are used to more quickly respond to changing market needs or trends.
* Creates appropriate pricing templates that conform to pricing standards required by the business.
* Directs scenario analysis, what if comparisons, sensitivity analysis, on key deal during deal structuring cycle.
* Accounts for the transfer of the pricing knowledge to the GDC delivery team to ensure the ongoing management of the commercial aspects of contracts.
* Directs the analysis identifying common trends and issues around pricing and competitive situations, learnings from deals, pricing pressures, competitive pressures, loopholes, etc., encountered in day-to-day management of the region.
* Accountable for capturing knowledge into artefacts that can be used to support new pursuits and ensure it is embedded in company's overall approach – for example. updated costing and pricing policies, models.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Advanced knowledge and understanding of IT industry environment and business needs.
* Advanced knowledge of the industry including competitors and market trends.
* Advanced knowledge of vendor pricing and commercial model (for example. Cisco and Microsoft license model / VMW license model).
* Keen eye for identifying opportunity.
* Advanced analytical and research skills.
* Advanced verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced negotiations and problem-solving skills.
* High level of drive and ability to work under pressure.
* Advanced understanding of global commerce and business capabilities and policies for global deals.
* Ability to build and maintain cross-functional relationships with a variety of stakeholders.
* Maintains a high level of knowledge of product and service offerings, including new offerings.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Commercial or related field.

**Required experience:**

* Advanced demonstrated experience working with business intelligence software.
* Advanced demonstrated relevant experience in similar role within a related environment.
* Advanced demonstrated pricing experience as a consultant or practitioner with a history of developing and implementing innovative pricing solutions.
* Advanced demonstrated experience in commercial modelling using MS Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**
  across practices and geographies to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design conflicts and avoid duplicated effort.
* **Drive the innovation agenda**
  : identify emerging technologies, run experiments and spikes, and convert successful ones into reusable accelerators, frameworks and IP.
* **Build the capability bench**
  — define skill paths, run internal enablement sessions and raise the architectural maturity of the practice.
* **Represent Cyient externally**
  through whitepapers, conference talks, partner forums and customer advisory sessions.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in a formal architect role on large-scale distributed systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure (preferred) or equivalent depth in AWS or GCP — demonstrable production ownership, not design-deck experience alone.
* Proven delivery of at least one production agentic AI or applied GenAI solution, from architecture through evaluation, guardrails and go-live.
* Strong data engineering background: lakehouse architectures, distributed processing (Spark), streaming and enterprise-scale data governance.
* Demonstrated presales and customer-facing track record — owned technical solutioning on proposals and RFPs that converted.
* Hands-on coding credibility in Python and one of Java / C# / Scala; able to build a POC personally when it matters.
* Experience with DevOps and platform engineering practices: CI/CD, IaC, containerisation, Kubernetes and observability tooling.
* Track record of mentoring senior technical talent and leading architecture communities of practice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to hold a room of engineers and a room of executives with equal effect.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or AI Engineer Associate (AI-103); equivalent AWS certifications equally valued.
* Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability standards and enterprise agent platforms.
* Domain exposure in one or more Cyient focus verticals: Aerospace & Defence, Rail & Transportation, Energy & Utilities, MedTech / Healthcare, Semiconductor or Communications.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, platforms or IP adopted across multiple accounts.
* Prior work in a services, consulting or systems-integrator environment with multi-client, multi-geography delivery.
* Published thought leadership, patents or active open-source contribution.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS SNAPSHOT**

**Area**

**Technologies & Practices**

**Cloud Platforms**

Azure (AKS, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor); AWS or GCP equivalents

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight LLMs; LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP; RAG, vector stores, evaluations, guardrails, LLMOps

**Data Engineering**

Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake; Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, ADF, dbt, Delta Lake; Purview, Unity Catalog

**Architecture Patterns**

Microservices, event-driven, domain-driven design, API-first, lakehouse / medallion, multi-tenancy, zero-trust security

**Engineering & DevOps**

Python, SQL, Java / C# / Scala; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / Bicep, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry

**Consulting Skills**

Discovery workshops, solution storytelling, estimation, RFP response, POC and demo build, executive communication

title: Solutions Architect - Digital Buildings
description:
**FPC Digital.**

At FPC Digital, we are driven by a bold vision: to become a global leader in digitally transforming real estate into secure and sustainable environments that set the digital building standard and benefit both people and our planet.

Our mission is clear: to empower the global delivery of intelligent, secure and vendor-agnostic digital buildings that prioritize human-centric design, operational effectiveness and sustainability.

As an aspiring leader in Digital Building Design, Delivery and Operations, FPC Digital specializes in creating spaces that are not only smart and connected but also environmentally responsible. With a dedicated team operating across the Americas, EMEA, APAC and India, we are shaping a more innovative and sustainable built environment.

**Job Description**

**Overview.**

We are looking for a Digital Buildings Architect to support the design and delivery of digital building solutions across international projects.

This role sits within the Digital Engineering team and focuses on smart building design, systems integration and digital infrastructure. You will work alongside senior architects and engineers to help shape how Independent Data Layers, building systems, networks and cloud platforms are brought together to deliver secure, sustainable and human centric buildings.

The ideal candidate will architect integrated solutions across BMS, IoT, analytics, and enterprise platforms while managing engineering teams and ensuring successful project execution from concept through handover.

**Key Responsibilities.**

Support Solution Architecture and Integration Design.

* Assist senior colleagues in developing digital building architectures covering building systems, networks, cloud platforms and Independent Data Layers.
* Help document integration between systems such as BMS, HVAC, lighting, metering, access control, vertical transport, IoT devices and workplace applications.
* Prepare and maintain technical artefacts including diagrams, data flow maps, interface schedules, device lists and point schedules.
* Contribute to the definition of IP addressing, VLAN structures, device naming and tagging that support scalability, security and analytics.

Smart Building Requirements, Energy and User Outcomes.

* Work with senior architects, project managers and client stakeholders to capture and refine smart building requirements, user journeys and use cases.
* Support the design of solutions that improve comfort, wellbeing, maintainability, space utilisation and energy performance, not just connectivity.
* Assist in selecting and specifying sensors, platforms and analytics tools that support optimisation, FDD and reporting against ESG and performance KPIs.

Cybersecurity and OT Network Support.

* Help apply secure by design principles to digital building architectures, aligned with client policies and recognised standards.
* Support coordination with client IT and security teams on topics such as segmentation, remote access and monitoring.
* Contribute to OT cyber risk assessments and remediation activities on projects, under guidance from senior team members.

Delivery Coordination, QA and Technical Support

* Support the Digital Solutions and MSI teams through the full project lifecycle, from concept and design through construction, commissioning and handover.
* Assist in reviewing contractor and vendor submissions for alignment with the agreed architecture, standards and scope.
* Help develop integration test plans, commissioning scripts and data validation checklists, and support their execution on projects.
* Provide day to day technical support to project managers and site teams, escalating complex issues to senior architects as needed.

Client, Stakeholder and Partner Engagement

* Participate in client workshops, design meetings and technical reviews, contributing to discussions and capturing actions and requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical content for proposals, scopes of work, deliverables and client presentations.
* Help coordinate with technology partners and vendors to align solutions, clarify interfaces and resolve design questions.

Standards, Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement

* Use and help refine FPC Digital’s standards, templates and playbooks for MSI, IDL, smart building design and OT cyber.
* Contribute to internal knowledge libraries, lessons learned and case studies from live projects.
* Take part in training sessions, brown bag talks and communities of practice, both as a learner and, over time, as a contributor.

Team Leadership & People Management

* Lead and mentor solution engineers, deployment coordinators, and technical specialists.
* Support resource planning and team allocation across programs.
* Support hiring, training, performance management, and career development.
* Build technical capability within the remote center of excellence.

**Qualifications**

**Education.**

* Preferred: Degree in Engineering, Building Services, Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent industry experience will be considered.
* Additional training or certifications in any of the following would be beneficial but not essential:

  + Controls, BMS or systems integration
  + Networking fundamentals
  + Cloud platforms, data engineering or analytics

**Experience.**

* Industry Expertise:

  + Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, or related field).
  + 12–15 years of experience in BMS, smart buildings, or digital infrastructure
  + Exposure to commercial, workplace, life sciences, mixed use or similar building projects is preferred.
  + Strong knowledge of: Niagara Framework, BACnet / BACnet SC, Modbus,MQTT,,OPC, Cloud IoT platforms
  + Experience managing teams
  + Good to have knowledge of OT cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, IEC 62443).
* Technical Skills:
  + Good understanding of at least some key building systems and protocols, for example BMS, HVAC, lighting, metering, access control, BACnet, Modbus, MQTT or REST APIs.
  + Experience with integration design, data flows or connecting systems through gateways, APIs or middleware is desirable.
  + Awareness of IP networking concepts (addressing, VLANs, routing, firewalls) and an interest in developing deeper OT networking skills.
  + Interest or experience in analytics, FDD, dashboards, digital twins or data visualisation is beneficial.
  + Any exposure to tagging standards or ontologies (for example Haystack, Brick, custom schemas) would be a plus.
* Soft Skills:
* Clear written and verbal communication, able to present technical information in a structured and accessible way.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with attention to detail in documentation and design outputs.

**Additional Information**

**Our Culture and Values.**

At FPC Digital, our values guide everything we do:

Integrity: We act with honesty, accountability and a commitment to doing what’s right.

Diversity and Inclusion: We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster an inclusive environment where everyone thrives.

Collaboration: By working together, we unlock creativity and deliver exceptional results for our clients.

Effectiveness: We strive to deliver impactful solutions that maximize value and drive measurable outcomes.

**Why Join Us?**

FPC Digital is more than a company, it’s a mission-driven organization focused on delivering human-centric, effective and sustainable solutions. We value professional development, continuous learning and work-life balance.

* Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), including GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams

title: Success Architect
description:
**Description**
**Success Architect**
**Role Description**
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success.
  
  
Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customer's first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational 'Guide' sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long-term success.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will:**

* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
* Innovate & Solve Problems – Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.

* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.

Solution Design & Architecture

Communication & Leadership

Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

title: Senior Associate, Federal Grants
description:
**Why Ryan?**

* Global Award-Winning Culture
* Flexible Work Environment
* Generous Paid Time Off
* World-Class Benefits and Compensation
* Rapid Growth Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Two-Way Transportation
* Exponential Career Growth

The Senior Associate, Federal Grants will work directly with Ryan team members and Ryan clients/companies to support the development of government funding applications and proposals by playing a key role in researching requirements and writing and editing application and proposal content as a member of a grant writing team. They may also support Ryan in post-award compliance activities and provide other grant-related support requested by clients. In addition, the Senior Associate will lead research on U.S. government grants, loans, and contracts and related legislation to ensure the firm's grants knowledge is continually updated. The position will demand high attention to detail and the ability to multi-task in constantly changing environments. The position requires strong writing, critical thinking, decision-making, and analysis skills as well as an ability to comprehend and synthesize complex concepts and communicate clearly with stakeholders. The position requires the ability to effectively use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance workflow efficiency while exercising independent judgment and critical thinking when evaluating information and making decisions.
  
  
The position involves significant project management skills to research and support the development and writing of grant and loan applications and contract proposals that are anticipated to range from $100,000 to $100,000,000+ in size. These funding applications are positioned to assist our clients’ businesses with their unique projects and could cover a wide array of industries included, but not limited to: energy, agriculture, health, manufacturing, industry, education, and research and development.
  
  
**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**
**People**

* Overall Team Support: Our team works together to support multiple clients and priorities simultaneously. The Senior Associate will be communicating, collaborating, and working directly with Ryan Managers and Consultants and third party stakeholders.
* Project Management: This role involves leading and writing multiple, concurrent projects and managing them effectively to ensure the final products meet internal and client standards.
* Administrative Duties: Recordkeeping and reporting to senior management, including use of Ryan’s internal file and client management systems.
* Internal Meetings: Meeting preparation and facilitation for internal weekly Grant team meetings. (The primary Grants team members are currently located in Washington, DC on Eastern Time so the Senior Associate shall assume that the weekly meetings, and any client support meetings, will occur in line with Eastern Time zone.)
* Other: The Senior Associate will be called on to support special projects, high-priority items, new/existing funding program research, review of existing materials, and updates and enhancements to team products and marketing materials, etc.

**Client**

* Funding Strategizing and Project Scoping: The Senior Associate will be responsible for researching specific funding opportunities for Ryan clients and as such will need to develop a strong understanding of our clients’ projects and areas of investment. The Senior Associate will gather/synthesize project information, identify possible grants and funding opportunities of potential relevance, and prepare reports and materials to summarize the scoped opportunities for review by Ryan staff and ultimate presentation and sharing with clients.
* Information Gathering and Analysis: Support client engagements, company and project information gathering, project scoping and strategizing, and communicating program and project details to Ryan staff and clients, if/as requested.
* Client Relationship Management: The Senior Associate may be invited to client meetings and as such will be required to manage client requests and expectations effectively. They will develop strong working relationships with Ryan staff and clients to ensure project completion and successful submission of requested deliverables.

**Value**

* Conduct Ongoing Grants Research (30%): Support with ongoing grant program research to ensure the Firm’s knowledge is up to date. This involves researching through a variety of online sources, including current U.S. Federal appropriation and legislative materials, reviewing client data and publicly available reports and information on grant and funding vehicles.
* Support Application and Proposal Research, Preparation, Writing, and Reviewing (30%): Either on their own or with a Ryan team member, work on the preparation and submission of funding applications and proposals for clients. This includes synthesizing project information gathered from research, client meetings, notes from the sales team or Manager, and previous funding proposals. They will evaluate and interpret quantitative and qualitative information from credible sources; identify supporting evidence and trends, and incorporate properly cited data into applications. The Senior Consultant will be asked to develop narrative content, budget materials, and graphically rich appendices and executive summary materials. An Engagement Manager, Director, or Senior Consultant will review work and provide feedback for changes or improvement before submitting.
* Support Systemization and Document Management (20%): As documentation for a project comes in, the Senior Associate will be responsible for filing and storing the documents appropriately on our system and ensuring they can be located for later use. The Senior Associate is responsible for maintaining the integrity and consistency of our file management system. The Senior Associate may be asked to analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and provide data-driven recommendations.
* Provide Sales and Marketing Support (20%): The Senior Associate will support, and sometimes lead, the development of marketing materials and sales tools and other thought leadership documentation to assist in the marketing and sales process for the U.S. federal grants sub-practice.

**Education And Experience**
A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business/Administration, English or Communications/Journalism, or a related discipline is required. Prior experience in Grants, familiarity with U.S. government programs, and broad business experience and business plan writing would be strong assets.
  
  
**Qualifications Required**

* 2-3 years of experience in industry with progressive responsibility
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce CRM
* Excellent writing skills and experience presenting written submissions C level executives
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills
* High comfort level working independently and in a team environment
* Strong decision-making skills: ability to work with limited information
* Strong research skills
* Ability to work confidently under pressure with tight timelines
* Experience working in a client facing role
* English fluency, both oral and written

**Qualifications Preferred**

* Experience writing grant or contract proposal narratives
* Expertise leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support research and content development
* Experience reporting to, or working with, clients and business leaders
* Strong ability to manage client expectations
* Industry experience in roles that include strategic planning, project management, or similar
* Demonstrated editorial, graphic design, or marketing skills

**Computer Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must have intermediate knowledge of Microsoft® Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, and Internet navigation and research. Experience with generative AI tools is also preferred.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities**
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. * Enterprise consulting

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.

**Who Thrives Here**

* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.

* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions

* Implementation thinking without business context

title: Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
**About the Company**

COMPANY OVERVIEW AND JOB SUMMARYUSTECH Solutions is a global IT services partner to Fortune 500 companies, delivering AI, Data, Cloud and Application Services at enterprise scale. Our work sits inside our clients' core systems — in financial services, insurance, healthcare and enterprise SaaS — where engineering quality, security and regulatory posture matter as much as speed. The Forward Deployed Engineering practice is how we bring that capability directly into a client's engineering organization.

**About the Role**

The FDE Lead is the senior technologist we embed inside a client's engineering organization to turn an AI ambition into running, supported software. The role carries two jobs at once: solution architect for the application estate being changed, and engineering lead for the agentic systems built on top of it. You own the architecture from first business requirement through production release and hypercare, and you lead the pod that ships it. FDE Leads are embedded from week one and work in small senior pods, helping the client decide what is worth building, building it, and staying accountable through to production support. The role carries unusual latitude: you shape the roadmap alongside client architects, make the technology calls, and answer for the outcome. You are the technical face of USTECH Solutions in front of client engineering leadership and CXOs.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: APPLICATION SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for the applications in scope: current-state assessment, target-state blueprint, HLD and LLD, interface contracts and the migration path between them.
* Select the stack and patterns deliberately — microservices vs. modular monolith, event-driven vs. request-response, API gateway, caching, transaction boundaries — with trade-offs documented.
* Design the integration layer to legacy and packaged systems (core banking, ERP, mainframe, CRM) through secure abstraction layers, API facades and event streams rather than point-to-point coupling.
* Define the shared data architecture: canonical models, data contracts, lineage, masking and residency rules.
* Set and defend non-functional requirements — availability, latency, scalability, resilience, DR, observability, cost per transaction — and prove them through load and failure testing.
* Build security and compliance into the design (authN/authZ, secrets, encryption, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA as applicable) and produce the artifacts the client's architecture review board needs: ADRs, design documents, sequence and deployment diagrams, threat models, estimation models.
* Govern engineering quality across the pod: code standards, review discipline, test coverage, CI/CD, IaC and technical debt tracking.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: AGENTIC AI AND PLATFORM ENGINEERING**

* Architect and deploy intent-driven agentic workflows against real domain logic — underwriting, claims, regulatory checking, reconciliation, servicing, order-to-cash, IT operations.
* Build and tune context-aware RAG pipelines and vector store architectures over disparate enterprise sources, owning chunking, embedding, retrieval evaluation and drift.
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool and function calling, and multi-agent orchestration so agents act on enterprise systems within scoped permissions.
* Stand up evaluation frameworks and AI observability: golden datasets, regression suites, accuracy thresholds, latency and token cost tracking, tracing and prompt versioning.
* Establish guardrails and AI governance — deterministic controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, PII redaction, audit trails, model and prompt change management.
* Apply AI-native engineering to our own delivery (agent-assisted development, automated test and edge-case generation) and evidence the productivity gained.
* Stay platform-pragmatic across Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI and Anthropic, choosing per problem, cost envelope and client constraint.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: CLIENT ENGAGEMENT AND DELIVERY LEADERSHIP**

* Embed inside client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, operating with high autonomy through discovery ambiguity and directly in front of stakeholders.
* Translate business intent into technical specifications the pod and the agents can execute against, including domain constraints and acceptance criteria; challenge weak use cases early rather than building them.
* Present architecture, security posture, evaluation results and business outcomes to client engineering leadership and C-level stakeholders (CTO, CIO, CPO, Chief Risk Officer).
* Lead a small senior onshore-offshore pod through shaping, build, evaluation, release and hypercare, with visible delivery governance and honest status against committed outcomes.
* Support pre-sales for the practice: solution shaping, RFP and RFI responses, technical proposals, estimation, pricing inputs, proofs of concept and client workshops.
* Mentor engineers and architects, and contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and playbooks to the USTECH Solutions asset library from every engagement.

**KEY MEASURES OF SUCCESS**

* Production deploymentsEvery engagement reaches production; no prototype handed over without a production path
* Client outcomeValue evidenced in the client's own metrics, and a client willing to act as a reference
* Engineering velocityMeasured reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, review turnaround and manual test effort
* Quality and trustEvaluation and accuracy thresholds met before release; no security or compliance escalations
* Account growthFollow-on scope originating from the embedded work
* Reusable IP and talentAccelerators contributed from every engagement; pod members taking on architecture ownership

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* 15+ years in software engineering, application architecture, platform engineering or solution architecture, including 8+ years delivering high-scale enterprise products or services.
* Proven solution architect track record on the application side: owning target-state design, integration architecture, NFRs and technical estimation for multi-team programs.
* Full-stack depth across at least one primary ecosystem (Java / Spring, .NET, Node or Python), plus APIs, messaging, relational and NoSQL data stores, and cloud-native deployment on Azure, AWS or GCP.
* 3+ years hands-on with the modern AI stack — RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, tool and

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant, Customer Experience, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise\-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands\-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre\-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI\-native approaches into every engagement.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre\-sales leadership, and practice development.
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts


 \#\# Required Qualifications
   

  

 \#\#\# Technical Expertise
   

  

* \*\*10\+ years\*\* of hands\-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3\+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM\-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi\-region, multi\-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000\+ concurrent contacts


 \#\#\# Consulting \& Leadership
   

  

* \*\*Pre\-sales experience\*\* — led or co\-led 5\+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end\-to\-end delivery on engagements with 5\+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go\-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C\-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3\+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions


 \#\#\# Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
   

  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step\-by\-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands\-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi\-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real\-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Working Model
   

  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands\-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre\-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# About the Team
   

  

 AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI\-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
   

  

 We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
   

  

 \* \* \*
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Delivery (80%)


 Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi\-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real\-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M\+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go\-live
* Build production\-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third\-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI\-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex\-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real\-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre\-Sales Leadership (10%)
* Lead customer discovery conduct workshops, ideation sessions, and technical deep\-dives to understand customer pain points and define CX transformation roadmaps
* Create compelling proposals develop SOWs, technical architectures, effort estimations, and delivery plans for complex Connect engagements
* Present to C\-suite and senior stakeholders articulate business value, ROI projections, and differentiated solution approaches during competitive evaluations
* Support pipeline development collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and Engagement Managers to identify and qualify opportunities worth $500K–$5M\+

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional

**Role Name:** 
 Manager of Forecasting, BAI
   

  

**Department Name:**

**Role GCF:** 
 5
   

  

**About Amgen**
 Amgen is committed to unlocking the potential of biology for patients suffering from serious illnesses by discovering, developing, manufacturing, and delivering innovative human therapeutics. This approach begins by using tools like advanced human genetics to unravel the complexities of disease and understand the fundamentals of human biology. A biotechnology pioneer since 1980, Amgen has grown to be one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies, reaching millions of patients around the world and developing a pipeline of medicines with breakaway potential.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role Description:**
 The Business Analytics \& Insights team at Amgen plays a pivotal role as a strategic partner to many cross functional teams such as Commercial, Medical, Finance, R\&D, Corp Affairs, offering data\-backed insights crucial for driving the success of Amgen’s products and portfolio. As a
 **Manager, Forecasting** 
 at Amgen India, you will play a key role in delivering actionable, data\-driven insights to support decision\-making across therapeutic areas. This role supports global pipeline assets and requires flexibility in collaborating across geographies—including partners in the U.S., Portugal, and internal contract teams in India. The ideal candidate will possess strong pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics experience, high data fluency, and strong written \& verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively across multiple stakeholders groups \& geographies.
   

  

 This role reports to the Senior Manager of Forecasting and operates within the broader framework of Business Analytics \& Insights (BAI).
   

  

*This role is for Amgen’s India Hyderabad Office. You will work on\-site a minimum of 4 days a week.*
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Forecast Development:
+ Build, maintain, and enhance Excel\-based forecast models (patient, sales, Rx\-based, revenue).
+ Support pipeline forecasts across various BUs (final therapeutic area assignment TBD).
+ Assist in development of long\-range plans and annual operating plans.

* Analytics and Insight Generation:
+ Interpret large datasets from internal systems, syndicated sources, and custom analytics.
+ Apply business judgment founded on knowledge of pharma/biotech industry and Amgen products / business to integrate market dynamics, competitor insights, and assumptions into forecasts and communicate forecast results \& rationale effectively to a diverse group of stakeholders.

* Stakeholder and Cross Functional Team Collaboration:
+ Collaborate with forecasting teams in the U.S., India and Portugal to align on methodology and deliverables.
+ Partner with internal India contract workers to drive standardization and execution of model builds.
+ Closely work with cross functional teams representing Commercial, Finance, Medical, Value \& Access, Analytics, Insights, and CI
+ Demonstrate \& model Amgen value of being respectful to others and to a diverse working environment.

* Process \& Capability Enablement:
+ Contribute to building new forecasting capabilities in Amgen India.
+ Help develop reusable tools, templates, and forecasting frameworks.

* Technology \& Innovation:
+ Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, agentic research platforms) to enhance speed and depth of insights.
+ Stay up to date with forecasting best practices, including probabilistic modeling, digital workflows and AI tools \& capabilities.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree and 8 to 13 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical forecasting or commercial analytics


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Expertise in patient\-based and demand\-based forecasting
* High proficiency in Excel and working knowledge of Python/SQL is a plus
* Familiarity with syndicated pharmaceutical data sources (e.g., IQVIA, Evaluate, internal CRM systems)
* Experience using generative AI tools to aid insight generation or automate workflows
* Strong collaboration skills, including experience working in cross\-cultural virtual teams
* Project management skills \& ability to manage multiple projects effectively in a fast\-paced environment


 At Amgen, our mission is to serve patients. We recruit the best talent, build an environment that facilitates career growth, and provide staff with the opportunity to make significant contributions to patients and our business.

title: Demo Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.
   

  

 Yext is looking for a technically capable, commercially aware individual to join the Demo Engineering team as a
 **Demo Engineer** 
 .
   

  

 This is a mid\-level role designed for someone who has built solid hands\-on experience — whether as an Associate Demo Engineer or in a client\-facing delivery role supporting sales, pre\-sales, or product teams — and is ready to take on greater ownership, craft more sophisticated demo assets, and begin influencing how the team operates.
   

  

 The Demo Engineering team supports a wide range of internal partners — including Revenue (Sales and Solutions Engineering), Client Services, Marketing, and Product — by creating everything from polished standard demo environments to visionary "art of the possible" solutions that showcase what the Yext platform can do. As a Demo Engineer, you'll move from supported delivery to leading your own workstreams, mentoring Associates, and contributing meaningfully to the team's standards and capability.
   

  

 This role is based in India and is a core part of a globally connected Demo Engineering function, working closely with Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, and stakeholders across the Yext business.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Owning Demo Asset Creation, Development \& Deliverables**
* Own and deliver Demo Engineering requests end\-to\-end, from initial scoping through to final handoff, with minimal supervision.
* Build and customise demo environments that reflect prospect\-specific use cases, industry contexts, and the latest Yext platform capabilities.
* Take full ownership of Knowledge Graph data, connector and crawler configurations, and front\-end customisation within demo accounts.
* Maintain and iterate on demo environments proactively, keeping them current with product releases, new features, and evolving best\-practice configurations.
* Contribute to the development of reusable demo assets and standard builds that raise the baseline quality across the team.


**Platform Expertise \& Insight Generation**
* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of the Yext platform across Listings, Search, Pages, Knowledge Graph, Analytics, and Scout
* Independently conduct and interpret Yext Scout Reports, Knowledge Scans, and Analytics outputs to generate prospect\-ready insights
* Assess prospects' digital presence using SEO best practices, identifying optimisation opportunities and translating them into compelling pre\-sales narratives
* Prepare and own reports and supporting materials that directly enable Solutions Engineers in pre\-sales conversations — not just assist in their preparation
* Support connector and crawler setup activities, including more complex configurations, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues independently.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Act as a reliable, responsive partner to Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, the RFP team, Client Success, Field Marketing, and Product.
* Contribute meaningfully to scoping calls, bringing a point of view on feasibility, approach, and prioritisation.
* Build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders so that the Demo Engineering team is seen as a proactive partner, not just a request queue
* Stay ahead of product updates — including pre\-GA features — and actively share knowledge across the team and with SE stakeholders.
* Contribute regularly to the SE Confluence knowledge hub, producing well\-structured guides, edge case documentation, and reusable reference material.


**Operational Excellence**
* Own your Jira queue with discipline: tickets are accurate, up to date, and progressed without chasing.
* Take responsibility for your allocated areas of the Demo Library, ensuring they are maintained to a high standard.
* Proactively identify and flag process gaps or inefficiencies, and propose practical improvements.
* Uphold and contribute to the team's hygiene and ticketing standards — and help others do the same.


**What You Have**
* At least 2 years of experience in a demo engineering, solutions engineering, pre\-sales delivery, or client\-facing technical role — or equivalent experience executing deliverables on behalf of a global sales or solutions team.
* A degree or equivalent practical experience in Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
* Solid working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with the ability to make confident front\-end customisations in a demo context.
* Familiarity with using AI tools (LLMs, agents) to accelerate and enhance demo build and customisation tasks.
* A strong understanding of SEO best practices and digital presence concepts, with the ability to apply them in a pre\-sales context.
* Clear, credible communication skills — you can present ideas confidently to internal stakeholders and hold your own in scoping conversations.
* A self\-starting mindset: you manage your workload, hit your deadlines, and don't wait to be told what to do next.
* The ability to balance multiple concurrent deliverables across different stakeholder groups without dropping quality.


**Bonus Points**
* Direct experience with the Yext platform, or a comparable brand visibility, listings management, or AI search platform
* Working knowledge of JavaScript or broader front\-end development concepts
* Experience contributing to RFP responses, pre\-sales collateral, or similar revenue\-enabling deliverables
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS sales cycles and an understanding of how demo assets support different stages of the process
* Experience mentoring or supporting junior colleagues in a technical or delivery context.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
* 
+ You'll work at the forefront of AI and digital search technology, with direct visibility into how the world's leading brands manage their digital presence
+ You'll own real, complex work that has a tangible impact on enterprise sales cycles — this is not a support role.
+ You'll have clear progression pathways, with the opportunity to grow into a Senior Demo Engineer role and take on greater scope and influence over time
+ You'll collaborate with talented Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, Field Marketing, and Product teams across a global organisation.
+ You'll deepen highly practical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, the Yext platform, AI tooling, and Analytics — and become genuinely expert in applying them in a commercial context.


**Perks And Benefits**
 At Yext, we take pride in our diverse workforce and prioritize creating an engaged and connected working environment. Our ambitious mission is to transform the enterprise with AI search, and we know that to achieve that, we need a global team of innovators, visionary thought leaders, and enthusiastic collaborators passionate about making a meaningful impact in the world and contributing to an extraordinary culture.
   

  

**Benefits**
 We believe that people do their best when they feel their best — and to feel their best, they must be well\-informed, fuelled, and rested. To ensure our employees are at their best, we offer a wide range of benefits and perks, including:
   

  

* Performance\-Based Compensation: We offer an attractive bonus structure and stock options for eligible positions.
* Comprehensive Leave Package: Our leave package includes Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, Sick Leave, Casual Leave, Bereavement Leave, National Holidays, and Floating Holidays to ensure a healthy work\-life balance.
* Health \& Wellness Offerings: We provide medical insurance with 7L coverage, including enhanced parental and outpatient department (OPD) coverage for you, your spouse, two dependent children, and two parents (as applicable and subject to eligibility requirements).
* Relocation Benefits: We offer relocation assistance and an allowance to eligible candidates to help ease your transition.
* World\-Class Office \& Building Amenities: Our office has a top\-notch infrastructure, including gaming rooms, a plush pantry, and breakout areas.


 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers.
   

  

 It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form.
   

  

**Security Alert**
 All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - B2B
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for the execution of change programs. We rely on our team’s expertise and specialisms to engage with executive\-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Salesforce Consultant with expertise in Commerce Cloud B2B and Order Management System (OMS) to provide our clients with strategic guidance, implementation, and support. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of B2B commerce and OMS processes and hands\-on technical consulting experience in a major software domain, along with proficiency in both English and French languages.
   

  

**Technical consultants** 
 demonstrate thought leadership in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of solutions, including enterprise integrations using middleware tools and platforms. As such, they are responsible for the analysis of options and subsequent presentations and education of the customer/partner. They will also identify and proactively handle risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through completion.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into Salesforce solutions leveraging Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS).
* Design, configure, and customize Salesforce solutions to meet client needs, including but not limited to product catalog management, pricing, quoting, and order management processes.
* Lead Salesforce implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, and deployment. Provide ongoing support and maintenance for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS) implementations, including troubleshooting issues and optimizing system performance.
* Develop and deliver training sessions and documentation for clients to enable them to effectively utilize Salesforce solutions.
* Stay current on Salesforce best practices and industry trends, particularly related to Commerce Cloud B2B and OMS, and proactively share knowledge with internal teams and clients.
* Work independently and as part of a distributed team, taking ownership of problems and rapidly learning new technologies.
* Build and maintain key relationships with key decision\-makers, demonstrating strong presentation, communication, and facilitation skills.
* Available to travel regionally and occasionally internationally depending on customer needs.
* Champion an AI\-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate custom Apex, LWC, and integration delivery while maintaining platform governor limit compliance
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize daily development velocity, document custom code, and maintain strict platform security standards
* Contribute to broader goals by becoming a citizen philanthropist and giving back to our communities through volunteering activities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience working with Salesforce, with a focus on Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS), or equivalent experience in a similar role.
* Proven track record of successful Salesforce implementations, including experience with full project lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and OMS processes and best practices.
* Experience with Salesforce integrations, including third\-party systems and APIs, is preferred.
* Experience in defining and delivering enterprise applications on the Salesforce Platform, including coded solutions.
* Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, and Salesforce Certified Platform Developer, are a big plus.
* Hands\-on technical consulting and solution implementation experience for a major software domain (e.g., CRM, ERP, HR), including design skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as well as coding experience in Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC), or any other object\-oriented languages/stack (Spring, Java, Angular, React, ...).
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with clients and internal teams.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Self\-motivated and able to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
