title: Product Deployment Engineer
description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C\+\+, Python).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* 8 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer\-side web technologies.
* Practical experience configuring, querying, or troubleshooting CRM architectures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, or custom internal backends).
* Ability to absorb complex technical concepts and communicate them to a non\-technical audience effectively.
* Ability to work independently and to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with effective problem\-solving, analytical and project management skills.
* Demonstrated coding ability with Java or Python, and database knowledge with the ability to construct complex SQL queries.


**About The Job**
 As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross\-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.
   

  

 You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.
   

  

 The Product Deployment Engineering Team for Measurement Services, gTech Ads GCS, provides exceptional complex measurement implementation for Google’s top GCS advertising clients. This team serves as the critical bridge between GCS customer business requirements and gTech Ads’ service and engineering offerings.
   

  

 The core objective of the team is to unlock data foundations, specifically driving the adoption of complex Google data strength products (e.g., ECL, GTG). Team members collaborate with high growth customers on non\-standard, complex environments to unlock business growth and defend business. To achieve this, PDEs conduct comprehensive audits and deep\-dive sessions to diagnose technical environments, identify customer pain points, and enable product adoption.
   

  

 Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
   

  

 To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with sales and product leads, evaluate client technical maturity and first\-party data strategies to guide scalable solution adoption.
* Uncover custom technical opportunities while funneling critical product gaps and edge cases back to core Ads engineering.
* Translate client needs into clear system architectures, author prototype\-grounded requirement documents and standardized deployment playbooks.
* Design durable, privacy\-compliant data pipelines—including Google Ads API integrations—and enforce validation frameworks using real\-world data subsets.
* Orchestrate cross\-functional efforts across gTech and client teams to oversee smooth implementation and successful last\-mile activation.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines

 Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangements

 Develop and build Real Time Optimization models for refineries, plants that typically involve design, development/configuration, and on\-line closed\-loop implementation of detailed process simulation models utilizing a state\-of\-the\-art real\-time optimization development tool.
   

  

***And/or***
 Develop and Build Planning/ Scheduling models for Refineries/ Petro Chemical/ Plants that typically involve Design, Model Building and implementation using state\-of\-the\-art USC Planning and Scheduling tools.
   

  

***And/or***

* Build various Real Time Optimization, Reconciliation and Economic models using in\-house process industry tools such as APO, APA \& AUSC

title: Professional, Integrations
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
 As an Integration Support Professional at Accurate, you will drive Accurate's future growth engine by assisting Accurate’s Onboarding Team and clients through the onboarding/integration process and turning them into happy users. Additionally, you will collaborate with multiple internal departments to ensure clients and Accurate are positioned for short and long term success.
   

  

 A full degree of creativity and latitude are expected in this role to facilitate delivery of results to our business. Being consultative and solutions\-oriented are critical for this position.
   

  

**This Role Is For You If**
* You have an in\-depth understanding of integrated solutions using different methods of communication (i.e., API’s, periodic files, etc.).
* You have worked with cross\-functional teams to problem solve and provide ideal solutions to achieve client objectives.
* You thrive on the urgency and importance of working with our clients and are capable of independently triaging reported issues/bugs related to their integrated solution and leading the effort to resolve.
* You want to actively increase a client’s overall satisfaction with their integrated solution and help Accurate understand the benefits of client requested changes/improvements.
* You have the passion and drive to change the job applicant/candidate and recruiter experience for the better.
* You can engage in business\-level and technical conversations with internal and external clients.


 At Accurate, we're transforming the background screening experience through innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to client success. As a fast\-growing organization, we partner with leading employers to deliver seamless screening and credentialing solutions that help build safer, more trusted workplaces. We foster a collaborative, results\-driven culture where new ideas are welcomed, learning is encouraged, and career growth opportunities are plentiful. If you're looking to make an impact while working alongside a talented team in a dynamic environment, Accurate could be the place for you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will triage client reported issues in relation to their ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or API integrations. Additionally, you will assist clients and the Accurate Onboarding Team in integration configuration and testing, as well as answer open client questions in relation to integrations, provide clarification on solutions, etc.
   

  

* Act as an initial point of contact for all client reported integration issues or concerns through ticketing system.
* Troubleshoot complex data flow issues between Accurate and third\-party ATS, HRIS, and recruiting platforms.
* Analyze API requests, responses, error logs, and webhook deliveries to identify root causes of integration issues and either offer potential solutions OR escalate accordingly.
* Maintain communication with stakeholders regarding resolution of reported issues.
* Understand client integration requirements and system capabilities and be able to translate accordingly.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for platform\-specific integration capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
* Work closely with clients and ATS representatives to identify account setup and integration requirements.
* Work closely with Onboarding to properly configure clients for specific integrations, considering any client specific initiatives/requirements.
* Provide support for integration testing.
* Translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* A familiarity with integrated API solutions and ability to explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to understand, evaluate, and translate complex client requirements into practical integration solutions.
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills combined with a commitment and proven ability to succeed within a fast\-paced organization.
* Strong overall interpersonal skills and a history exceeding client expectations.
* Time\-management skills and the ability to establish reasonable and attainable deadlines for resolution.
* Self\-motivated professional with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Basic knowledge of XML and JSON required.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and databases required.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Experience with related tools such as Postman, SOAP UI, etc., a plus.
* Background Screening experience a plus.


**The Accurate Way**
 We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
   

  

**Take ownership.**
 Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
   

  

**Be open.**
 Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
   

  

**Stay curious.**
 Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
   

  

**Work as one.**
 Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
   

  

**Equal opportunities**
 Accurate is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
   

  

**Special Notice**
 Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.
   

  

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.
* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in\-person format.
* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

description:

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world.  Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams.  Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Position Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Business Consultant to join our consulting team focused on the group benefit and retirement, specifically catering to US group benefit, group insurance and retirement clients. The ideal candidate will possess 3 to 8 years of relevant experience for Senior level a strong understanding of the insurance industry, and exceptional consulting skills. This is a full\-time position that offers the opportunity to work on impactful projects and drive value for our clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead and manage consulting projects for US group benefit and retirement clients, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to analyze client needs, develop tailored solutions, and implement best practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Full\-time MBA from a reputable institution.
* 3 to 8 years of experience in business consulting, with a focus on the insurance sector, particularly group benefits and retirement.
* Strong domain knowledge of insurance process, products, regulations, and market dynamics.
* Proven consulting skills, including project management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong client management skills, with a focus on building lasting relationships and delivering exceptional service.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Solutions Architect-3
description:
Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
* Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
* Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Oversee the management of non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to other IT architects to develop their skills and expertise in solution architecture leadership and execution.


 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training or work experience. Relevant Master’s degree, TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Eight (8\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Fluency in English
* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management


**Preferred Qualifications**

**Pay**
**Additional Details:**
 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity.  Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-Hybrid Infra
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description – AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth** 
**Within S\&T, the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure strategy capability plays a critical role in shaping how organizations modernize their core technology foundations to enable digital, cloud, and AI\-led transformation. As a Strategy professional in this space, you will help clients define their enterprise\-wide AI and hybrid infrastructure strategy, help them make sense of their AI consumption economics, identify value creation and cost optimization opportunities, and design future\-ready operating models that bridge business ambition with technical reality.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. You’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy is your next move.**
**The Team**
 The AI and Hybrid Infrastructure team sits at the core of Deloitte’s technology\-enabled transformation agenda. We advise clients on where and how to modernize their infrastructure landscape — spanning data centers, hybrid and multi\-cloud platforms, networks, and AI\-enabled infrastructure — to support business growth, resilience, and innovation.
   

  

 Our work is strategy\-led and outcome\-oriented, focused on helping executives make clear, data\-driven decisions on topics such as:
   

  

* AI Infrastructure strategy
* AI Economics / Tokenomics strategy
* Hybrid Cloud strategy
* Enterprise Infrastructure and platform enablement
* Legacy modernization and technical debt reduction
* Cost optimization, resilience, and scalability
* Technology operating model and governance design
* AI / Hybrid Cloud sourcing strategies


 Strategy professionals in this team act as trusted advisors to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business leaders, translating complex business problems into actionable technology choices. We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who combine strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of modern infrastructure and AI ecosystems.
   

  

**Work You Will Do**
 As part of the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy team, you will work with clients to shape and execute their AI infrastructure and platform strategies across hybrid environments (Cloud. On\-premise, Edge) ensuring alignment with broader business and digital transformation goals.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include supporting enterprise infrastructure and AI platform strategies (including hybrid and multi\-cloud adoption roadmaps, investment prioritization, and value realization cases), advising clients on high\-level AI\-ready infrastructure architectures, designing target\-state technology operating models, compute and token consumption strategies, including trade\-offs between cost, performance, scalability and conducting strategic assessment and diagnostics across infrastructure, AI platforms and MLOps. This role provides exposure to complex, high\-visibility transformation programs and enables you to build deep expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and enterprise infrastructure in a client\-facing consulting environment.
   

  

**Required Experience And Skills**
* Ability to translate complex infrastructure and AI architecture concepts into clear business value narratives for executive and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong understanding of how infrastructure, cloud, data and AI investments drive growth, cost efficiency, risk reduction, and operational resilience
* Ability to articulate emerging trends, best practices, and strategic implications of AI infrastructure and hybrid cloud adoption across industries
* Infrastructure, Cloud and AI domain knowledge:
* Foundational understanding of enterprise infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, and hybrid / multi\-cloud architectures
* Understanding of AI/ML lifecycle (training, fine\-tuning, inference) and concepts such as tokens, RAG, LLMs, Vector Databases etc.
* Understanding of cost drivers in AI and infrastructure (e.g., compute, storage, token usage, cloud consumption models) and ability to support cost\-benefit analysis and TCO evaluations
* Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, platforms, frameworks, ecosystems (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, NVIDIA AI platforms) and their infrastructure implications
* Understanding of key compliance, security, and regulatory standards relevant to Infrastructure and AI environments (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF)
* Architecture \& Transformation Experience: Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience in either one or more of the following areas:
* AI or cloud infrastructure strategy, architecture, or large\-scale transformation initiatives
* Design or assessment of AI/ML platforms, MLOps workflows, or AI\-ready infrastructure environments
* Infrastructure modernization, cost optimization, or operating model transformation programs
* AI Economics and optimization
* Exposure to integrating compute, networking, and storage capabilities to support scalable AI or cloud workloads, with an emphasis on architectural decision\-making rather than hands\-on operations
* Experience supporting ecosystem\-driven solutions and working with technology partners to shape solution options and recommendations
* Ability to support benchmarking, performance assessments, and business case development to inform infrastructure and AI investment decisions
* Experience defining target operating models (TOMs), roadmaps, governance frameworks, and process designs
* Exposure to security, governance, and compliance considerations across infrastructure and AI stacks
* Interest in contributing to internal knowledge development, POVs, or client thought leadership as part of broader practice growth
* Exposure to working with non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Network \- ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant STEM Field (ex. Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics) from a premier school in India or abroad
* MBA, MS, M. Tech. from a premier school in India or abroad, with a background in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, etc.
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in in roles involving technology strategy, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, or large\-scale infrastructure and cloud initiatives
* Relevant certifications in hybrid cloud/AI infrastructure space would be nice to have (e.g., TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CISM, CISSP, CEH)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem‑solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

**Travel \& Work Arrangements/Requirements**
* Primarily office‑based role in Hyderabad.

**Key Competencies**
* Expertise in Wastewater treatment process knowledge.
* Strong costing and BOQ preparation skills.

* Cross‑functional coordination \& communication.

title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
description:
**Description**
 Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.

These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

title: Program Management (Technical), Principal
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years managing technical programs where the stakes are real: a missed milestone means a customer's tape\-out slips, a miscommunication means a silicon spin, and a poorly managed risk means millions of dollars and months of schedule lost. You know that program management in the IP world is not about status reports, it is about being the person who sees around corners, catches the integration issue before it becomes a blocker, and keeps a dozen moving parts aligned across time zones and organizations.
   

  

 You are comfortable sitting in a room with a customer's SoC architect talking through their power budget and walking out with a clear plan for how your IP fits their roadmap. You do not wait for perfect information. You ask the right questions, synthesize what matters, and drive decisions that keep programs moving. You have managed enough programs to know when a schedule is real and when it is wishful thinking, and you are not afraid to escalate early.
   

  

 You think in terms of outcomes, not activities. You care about whether the customer gets to tape\-out on time with IP that works, not whether your slides look polished. At Synopsys, you will work with tier\-one customers on programs that define the next generation of SoCs, and the IP portfolio you manage will end up in products that ship at scale.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end IP development programs for tier\-one customers, from initial requirements through silicon bring\-up, ensuring delivery against committed schedules and specifications
* Serve as the primary technical and operational point of contact between customers and Synopsys cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, FAE, CAE, and R\&D
* Plan and drive program schedules across standard IP deliveries, custom IP development, and foundry process technology node transitions
* Identify, track, and escalate technical and schedule risks, driving issues to resolution across internal development teams and external customer stakeholders
* Coordinate IP integration activities with customer SoC design teams, ensuring successful acquisition, integration, and silicon validation
* Translate customer SoC requirements into actionable development plans, working with R\&D to align IP roadmaps with customer product timelines
* Communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders at multiple levels, from engineering teams to executive leadership


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to meet their SoC tape\-out schedules by delivering IP on time and to specification, directly affecting their product launch timelines
* Reduce customer integration risk by proactively identifying and resolving technical issues before they impact silicon bring\-up
* Expand Synopsys IP footprint in customer roadmaps by identifying opportunities for future SoC programs based on deep program engagement
* Improve cross\-functional execution by creating clarity across geographically distributed teams, reducing miscommunication and rework
* Strengthen customer relationships through consistent delivery and technical credibility, turning program success into long\-term partnerships
* Influence internal IP development priorities by bringing customer voice and real\-world integration challenges back to R\&D teams
* Shape how Synopsys executes complex, high\-stakes programs by setting the standard for technical program management in the Silicon IP business


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 10 to 15\+ years of relevant experience in program management or technical leadership roles
* Proven track record managing programs in analog and digital SoC design environments, with demonstrated ability to deliver complex technical programs on schedule
* Deep knowledge of IC manufacturing, process technology, design flow, and sign\-off processes, with the ability to speak credibly with customer engineering teams
* Understanding of memory and standard cell design, including how IP integrates into SoC design flows and what can go wrong during integration
* Experience working directly with customers in a technical or program capacity, managing expectations and navigating complex stakeholder environments
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with competing priorities, making clear trade\-off decisions and keeping teams aligned
* Strong technical communication skills, you can explain a complex integration issue to a customer architect and translate it into an actionable plan for internal R\&D


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to their SoC requirements, and come out with a clear understanding of what they actually need versus what they said they need
* You know when to escalate and when to solve, and you do not let issues sit hoping they will resolve themselves
* You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, you can start a program with incomplete requirements and drive the right conversations to fill in the gaps without stalling progress

title: Associate Demo Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.
   

  

 Yext is looking for a curious, technology\-minded individual to join the Demo Engineering team as an
 **Associate Demo Engineer** 
 .
   

  

 This is a brilliant entry\-level opportunity for someone who is enthusiastic about technology, excited to learn, and keen to build a career at the intersection of AI, digital search, and sales enablement.The Demo Engineering team supports a wide range of internal partners — including Revenue (Sales and Solutions Engineering), Client Services, Marketing, and Product — by creating everything from polished standard demo environments to visionary "art of the possible" solutions that showcase what the Yext platform can do.
   

  

 As an Associate, you'll learn the craft of demo engineering from the ground up, working alongside experienced engineers and solutions professionals in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 This role is based in India and is designed to give you real, hands\-on experience from day one — with clear development pathways into a full Demo Engineer role.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Supporting Demo Asset Creation, Development \& Deliverables**
* Support Senior Demo Engineers with delivering Demo Engineering requests. This will include assisting in building and maintaining standard demo environments using the Yext platform.
* Help customise demo accounts to reflect prospect\-specific use cases and industry contexts, guided by senior team members.
* Support updates to Knowledge Graph data, basic connector and crawler configurations, and front\-end elements.
* Help keep demo environments current with the latest Yext product features and configurations.


**Continuous Platform Learning \& Assistance of Deliverables**
* Continuously learn the Yext platform including Hearsay. Build a strong foundational understanding of the Yext platform, covering Listings, Search, Pages, and Knowledge Graph.
* Shadow Senior Demo Engineers and Solutions Engineers to learn how demos are scoped, built, and used throughout the sales cycle.
* Complete recommended certifications and participate in product enablement programmes.
* Learn SEO best practices and assist in assessing prospects' digital presence using these best practices, beginning to identify areas for improvement.
* Learn to understand the common data structures required to successfully support the generation of Yext Scout Reports.
* Learn to interpret Yext Analytics including Yext Scout.
* Learn to understand Yext Knowledge Scans; to evaluate a prospect's presence across digital Listings, user Reviews, and optimised web Pages.
* With guidance from Senior Demo Engineers, learn to prepare and support reports and materials to enable pre\-sales discussions led by Yext Global Solutions Engineers.
* Begin developing basic skills in HTML, CSS, and using AI tools (such as LLMs) to assist with front\-end customisation tasks.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Support the deal cycle by managing and responding to inbound requests from Solutions Engineers and Account Executives via Jira.
* Participate in scoping calls and team stand\-ups to develop an understanding of how work is prioritised.
* Stay close to product updates — including pre\-GA features — through internal channels and product communications.
* Share learnings and observations with the team via Slack and team meetings.
* Contribute to the SE Confluence knowledge hub by documenting what you've learnt, edge case handling, and useful guides for others.


**Operational Excellence**
* Keep your assigned Jira Tickets Demo up to date.
* Maintain and take responsibility for your allocated areas of the Demo Library.
* Follow team administration hygiene and ticketing standards so requests are tracked, prioritised, and delivered consistently.
* Be curious: ask questions proactively and surface blockers early — no one is expected to figure everything out alone.


**What You Have**
* A desire to develop a career in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role — relevant internships, placements, or academic projects are very welcome.
* A degree or equivalent practical experience in Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
* A basic awareness of HTML and CSS, or a genuine eagerness to learn.
* Clear, confident communication skills — you can explain ideas simply and work well with others.
* Genuine curiosity about technology, AI, and digital experiences.
* A coachable attitude and the motivation to grow quickly in a high\-performance environment
* The ability to manage multiple tasks and collaborate across teams effectively.
* Curiosity; the default mindset to want to understand why technical aspects work, behave, evolve and the value it brings to Yext clients.


**Bonus Points**
* Previous experience in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role.
* Any exposure to SaaS platforms, CMS tools, Analytics platforms or digital marketing and SEO concepts.
* A passing familiarity with JavaScript or basic front\-end development.
* Some experience or interest in data, structured content, or database concepts.
* An interest in how technology supports pre\-sales and revenue teams.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
* You'll work at the forefront of AI and digital search technology, gaining practical experience in one of the fastest\-evolving spaces in tech.
* You'll build real demo assets that directly support enterprise sales cycles — your work will matter from the start.
* You'll receive structured mentorship and development to help you grow into a full Demo Engineer role.
* You'll collaborate with talented Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, Field Marketing and Product teams across a global organisation.
* You'll develop highly practical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, the Yext platform, and AI tooling, Analytics — and learn how to apply them in a commercial context.


**Perks And Benefits**
 At Yext, we take pride in our diverse workforce and prioritize creating an engaged and connected working environment. Our ambitious mission is to transform the enterprise with AI search, and we know that to achieve that, we need a global team of innovators, visionary thought leaders, and enthusiastic collaborators passionate about making a meaningful impact in the world and contributing to an extraordinary culture.
   

  

**Benefits**
 We believe that people do their best when they feel their best — and to feel their best, they must be well\-informed, fuelled, and rested. To ensure our employees are at their best, we offer a wide range of benefits and perks, including:
   

  

* Performance\-Based Compensation: We offer an attractive bonus structure and stock options for eligible positions.
* Comprehensive Leave Package: Our leave package includes Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, Sick Leave, Casual Leave, Bereavement Leave, National Holidays, and Floating Holidays to ensure a healthy work\-life balance.
* Health \& Wellness Offerings: We provide medical insurance with 7L coverage, including enhanced parental and outpatient department (OPD) coverage for you, your spouse, two dependent children, and two parents (as applicable and subject to eligibility requirements).
* Relocation Benefits: We offer relocation assistance and an allowance to eligible candidates to help ease your transition.
* World\-Class Office \& Building Amenities: Our office has a top\-notch infrastructure, including gaming rooms, a plush pantry, and breakout areas.


 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers.
   

  

 It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form.
   

  

**Security Alert**
 All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

title: Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno-Functional)
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno\-Functional)
   

  

**Location:** 
 India(Remote)
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 8\+ Years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno\-Functional) to lead solution design and delivery for complex Quote\-to\-Cash (QTC) transformation initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy and hands\-on technical architecture—translating SaaS subscription models, multi\-product bundles, and data workflows into scalable Salesforce CPQ configurations and integration specifications. Candidates must have personally configured Salesforce CPQ and must have practical, hands\-on experience building AI agents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Quote\-to\-Cash Solution Design: Map and optimize the end\-to\-end sales journey, covering account creation/validation, opportunity management, quote generation, contract finalization, and order confirmation.
* Salesforce CPQ Architecture and Configuration: Design and maintain complex bundle structures (components vs. accessories), subscription/term\-based pricing models, renewal logic, and Quote Line Editor product/validation rules.
* Account Onboarding, MDM \& Routing: Design account creation and approval workflows. Configure territory and user routing based on geography, revenue, and employee headcount.
* Integration \& Data Architecture: Partner with engineering teams to define integration specs between Salesforce CPQ, Master Data Management (Informatica MDM), middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi), and downstream invoicing engines. Define the Salesforce and Informatica MDM integration for account validation, enrichment, and deduplication. This includes resolving conflicts between third\-party data (ZoomInfo, D\&B, SEC) and existing MDM records.
* Data \& Technical Validation: Write SOQL queries to analyze data models, troubleshoot configuration edge cases, and validate data migrations/enrichment pipelines.
* AI \& Emerging Tech: Assist in evaluating and setting up native AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce, sub\-agents) to automate internal workflows and user journeys.
* Agile Story Authoring: Write detailed user stories, process flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria while partnering with offshore development teams to drive sprint execution.


**Required Qualifications**

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Observe.AI is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale. The platform enables businesses to deploy specialized AI agents that autonomously execute work across the full CX lifecycle—from handling customer conversations to supporting frontline teams and optimizing operations.
   

  

 Each AI agent is purpose\-built for a specific role, equipped to understand context, make decisions, take action, and continuously improve outcomes. This allows organizations to increase resolution speed, elevate service quality, and reduce operational costs while empowering your frontline team to focus on higher\-value work.
   

  

 Built on a CX\-native foundation, Observe.AI helps leading brands like DoorDash, Affordable Care, Signify Health, and Verida improve customer satisfaction, boost agent productivity, and deliver consistent, scalable performance across every customer interaction.
   

  

 Why Join Us
   

  

 We’re looking for a client\-facing AI Agent Engineer to design, integrate, and deploy enterprise\-grade Voice and Chat AI agents and AI Copilots. This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role centered on bringing AI solutions to life within customer environments—not building foundational AI models.
   

  

 You will work directly with customers to translate requirements into working solutions by configuring integrations, designing prompts and workflows, and deploying scalable AI agents. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem\-solving across systems, working with APIs, and delivering real\-world AI applications.
   

  

 You’ll own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI agent delivery—from initial design and integration through testing, client demos, deployment, and ongoing iteration.
   

  

 What You’ll Be Doing
   

  

 Build \& Deploy Agents: Own the implementation of AI agents including prompt design, workflow configuration, integrations, telephony setup, and evaluation frameworks.
   

  

 Client Engagement: Act as the primary technical partner for customers—lead regular demos, communicate progress, gather feedback, and guide solutions from concept to production.
   

  

 Systems Integration: Configure and connect systems using APIs—handling authentication, data mapping, error handling, and integrations with CRMs, knowledge bases, and other enterprise tools.
   

  

 Telephony Integration: Set up SIP/CCaaS/PSTN routing, pass metadata, configure fallbacks, and troubleshoot call quality.
   

  

 Prompt Design \& Optimization: Write and refine prompts for LLM\-driven agents, monitor performance, test iteratively, and ensure agents meet automation and containment targets.
   

  

 Strategic Partner: Translate customer requirements into actionable solutions; work consultatively to unblock challenges in security, connectivity, or knowledge ingestion.
   

  

 Cross Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product/engineering teams to escalate platform gaps and resolve deep technical fixes and platformization, while independently driving leading client implementations.
   

  

 What You Bring to the Role
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
   

  

 1\-5 years in conversational AI, solution engineering, system integration, or delivering AI/LLM\-based applications in customer environments, software engineering, or system integration with hands\-on delivery of AI/LLM\-based solutions.
   

  

 Strong ability to communicate and lead customer\-facing discussions \- from deep technical troubleshooting to weekly project demos. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Must have strong hands\-on skills in prompt design, workflow building and API integration (SIP, Twilio, Amazon Connect, etc.).
   

  

 Familiarity with LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini), vector DBs, and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
   

  

 Working knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, implementation patterns and performance optimization.
   

  

 Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, or similar for scripting and integrations
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving mindset: ability to find workarounds, unblock integrations, and adapt to customer\-specific ecosystems.
   

  

 Experience with integration tools and Integration Platform\-as\-a\-Service (iPaaS) providers, such as n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms and proficiency in API integrations and data flow management is a plus.
   

  

 Familiarity with telephony or voice systems (SIP, CCaaS, PSTN) is a plus.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging
   

  

 Observe.AI is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Observe AI does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. Observe.AI also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.
   

  

 We welcome all people. We celebrate diversity of all kinds and are committed to creating an inclusive culture built on a foundation of respect for all individuals. We seek to hire, develop, and retain talented people from all backgrounds. Individuals from non\-traditional backgrounds, historically marginalized or underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.
   

  

 If you are ambitious, make an impact wherever you go, and you're ready to shape the future of Observe.AI, we encourage you to apply. For more information, visit www.observe.ai .

* Understanding of BTP Solution Design: Experience working with BTP solutions related to Business AI and Process Automation, with the ability to design and implement solutions that meet client requirements.
* Familiarity with Process Automation: Exposure to process automation solutions using SAP Build related offerings on the BTP, with the ability to develop and deliver high\-quality solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Advanced SAP AI Core Skills: Exposure to advanced features and functionalities of SAP AI Core, enabling the design and implementation of complex BTP solutions that meet client needs.

You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

description:
**The Next Level of Fire \& Life Safety Leadership**
 With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
   

  

 At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry\-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting\-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Aritech is looking for a full\-time Systems Cloud \& Integration Specialist to join our team. This role focuses on providing technical support, integrating third\-party systems, delivering tailored solutions to customers, troubleshoots various cloud\-based services, including databases \& learning management system to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and security. They are responsible for monitoring system health and resolving complex technical issues. This role implies close interaction with development and operations teams to align cloud strategies, training programs, processes and content development with business objectives particularly in the integration of security systems and APIs, optimizing resource utilization, and implementing industry best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide training and technical support to customers regarding system functionalities.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues efficiently.
* Troubleshoot and address issues with cloud infrastructure
* Install and maintain software, operating systems, and hardware components.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for cloud systems, including architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides
* Assist customers with tasks such as user profile creation, updates, and backups.
* Assist with the deployment and setup of cloud resources
* Manage and distribute technical documents to customers when required.
* Analyze cloud system performance metrics and logs to identify trends, forecast needs, and recommend improvements or upgrades
* Ensure the seamless integration of third\-party systems and APIs (e.g., security systems like cameras, intrusion sensors).
* Collaborate with internal teams and external integrators to ensure successful implementation of security solutions.
* Develop and implement customized solutions based on customer\-specific needs and requirements.
* Analyze customer and user requirements to design effective software solutions.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable software using languages such as C\+\+, Java, and Python.
* Troubleshoot technical issues related to APIs, providing level 1 and 2 support.
* Test software and cloud applications and make necessary adjustments to ensure reliability.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software bugs and performance issues.
* Write technical documentation and collaborate with Technical Writers.
* Recommend new technologies and improvements to enhance system performance and reliability.
* Follow up regularly and ensure the quality of integrations performed.


**Requirements**
* Fluent in English
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* At least 10 years of proven experience as a Cloud Support Engineer or in a similar position
* Strong understanding of cloud systems, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as C\+\+, Java, Python, and experience with web technologies like JSON, XML.
* Experience in integrating third\-party systems and API architecture.
* Strong diagnostic and problem\-solving skills for software development and debugging.
* Experience in developing and supporting REST APIs.
* Experience with security technologies such as surveillance cameras, intrusion sensors, etc., is a plus.
* Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills to work within a diverse engineering environment.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and resolve issues efficiently.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with physical security systems (e.g., cameras, sensors, intrusion systems).
* Experience with cybersecurity, particularly in data protection and system security.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
