title: SAP FI-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: Consulting \- FICO Senior Consultant**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Consulting is a fast\-moving, high\-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency \- Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk \& Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
   

  

 In this role we are looking for an experienced SAP S4 HANA FI Manager to join our growing SAP Finance team. In this role, you will lead and support SAP FI design, configuration, and implementation activities across a range of projects. You will work closely with business stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions within the SAP FI/CO landscape
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* The primary function of this position is to work as a team member in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively to the area of SAP S4 HANA FICO General Ledger, Accounts Payables, Accounts receivable, Bank Accounting Taxation, and Fixed Assets functionalities, Cost center and profit center Accounting, knowledge in COPA, Marginal Analysis, Product Costing and Material Ledger with a preferred background in the relevant industry.
* The Specialist will work in the implementation of all the above modules as part of the S4HANA Finance Transformation project, ensuring seamless integration with other third‑party systems.
* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the manager/lead


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
* Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow up on the action items from the workshops
* Experience on FIORI APPS, BO\-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools.
* Prior client facing consulting experience.
* SAP Finance/Controlling Certification is a plus


**What We Look For**
* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / ICMA/ MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 7 to 10 years in SAP FI.
* Experience of having worked in an onsite\- offshore delivery model
* Experience with leading business blueprint, gathering and documenting business requirements and designing SAP enabled solutions
* Development of project documentation including business process flows, training materials, requirements gathering and project management methodology experience required
* Experience should be in End\-to\-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.
+ SAP Finance – FI\- Organization structure, New General Ledger, FI\-Accounts Payable, FI\-Accounts Receivable, FI\-Bank accounting and FI\-Asset Accounting.
+ SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
+ SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions \& Reporting.
+ Controlling\- CO\-Cost Center Accounting, CO\-Profit Center Accounting and CO\-Internal Orders.
+ Knowledge and Hands on experience in CO\-Profitability Analysis \& Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling) and Material Ledger Actual Costing.
+ FI integration with MM, SD, PP \& PS.
+ Excellent business communication skills


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: IT&D Manager, Smart Execution
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Information Technology \& Digital
   

  

 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded IT\&D Manager to lead the Smart Execution capabilities of the Sales Execution platform globally. The primary role is to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the technology teams, owning the roadmap of the solution and manage the on\-going deployment and adoption within the markets. The ultimate objective is to deliver insights which create value and drive business forward in the space of route\-to\-market, in\-store execution and sales excellence, whilst ensuring synergy, cost effectiveness and appropriate levels of data governance.
   

  

 This candidate will need to demonstrate an effective communication and delivery skillset and collaborate confidently with mid\-senior levels of the organisation. We are looking for someone who can innovate, with the ability to encourage performance and motivate peers and the wider organisation to embrace advanced data \& analytics capabilities.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

 Capability Management
   

  

* Define and own the feature roadmap for the Smart Execution capabilities, including RTM, Routing, In\-store Execution and Order Recommendations
* Gather and translate business requirements from commercial and sales teams into technical user stories and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize backlogs and make decisions aligned to the business value
* Partner with the technology teams, data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and application developers to deliver the capabilities
* Manage the full technology lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, testing, and deployment
* Drive adoption of the Smart Execution capabilities across Sales (Retail Management, Key Account Management), Trade Marketing and Customer Supply, ensuring tools are effectively utilized to achieve business objectives
* Monitor usage and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement
* Utilize a deep understanding of FMCG categories and external data to inform development and deployment strategies
* Work closely with other teams within Sales Execution Platform for a seamless integration of AI within existing workflows
* Manage vendor relationships, including implementation partners


 Stakeholder Engagement:
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders of capabilities managed, building and maintaining strong relationships, and driving adoption
* Manage and communicate Roadmaps, providing details of delivery timelines, training and deployment to regional and market users
* Collaborate with and provide expertise and support to market teams, developing action plans based on analytical insights, refine processes and unlock new capabilities


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
   

  

* Partner with Global and Regional commercial teams to develop analytics best practices, maintain and deliver these in the markets in alignment with the IT operating model
* Work with other Global IT\&D Managers within the Sales Execution team to ensure alignment and leveraging the synergies between teams
* Ensure alignment of the technical delivery with the Reckitt’s data analytics platform \- Trinity data architecture standards, patterns and principles. Align changes where necessary
* Implement solutions aligned to global IT\&D enterprise architecture frameworks


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

 6\-8\+ years in business analysis, data science consulting or IT Management (with exposure to AI Product Management)
   

  

* Proven experience in designing, deploying and adopting analytical tools within commercial teams
* Experience in working with the Sales functions
* Preferred experience for role:
* FMCG / Consumer Goods experience preferred
* Previous hand\-on Data Science experience preferred
* Exposure to Modern Trade and/or Pharmacy/OTC sales channels


 The skills for success
   

  

* Technical Skills
* Familiarity with Sales Execution solutions or platforms
* Familiarity with Azure tech stack and Microsoft Power Platforms
* Ability to guide AI model development, managing trade\-offs between data availability, model accuracy and business value delivered
* Ability to evaluate model performance and translate model outputs into business insights to drive stakeholder buy\-in
* Designing experiments to measure value delivered and inferring/extrapolating results
* Delivering end\-to\-end ad hoc analyses including scoping, problem translation, solution design and insights generation
* Awareness of impact of solution architecture and solution design choices on infrastructure requirements
* Ability to write or review functional specifications
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and cross\-functional team collaboration


 Business Acumen
   

  

* Strong grasp of Sales Execution levers: execution compliance, on\-shelf availability, MSL, share of shelf etc.
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and processes into design and decisions


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Excellent stakeholder management across senior commercial and IT leadership
* Strong communication — able to speak both “business” and “tech”
* Analytical mindset with comfort around large datasets


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Argano is seeking a EPM Planning Consultant for our Client Services practice. A consultant in Argano Managed Services is an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM professional responsible for sustaining, optimizing, and continuously improving clients’ production environments after go\-live. The consultant manages a portfolio of client priorities, provides functional and technical leadership, and guides incident resolution, service requests, enhancements, and process improvements. Working collaboratively with client stakeholders, the Consultant helps protect operational stability, increase adoption, and deliver measurable business value. The role also mentors other consultants, contributes to reusable practices, and supports strong client satisfaction and long\-term account success.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Argano Managed Services helps clients sustain, optimize, and continuously improve their Oracle Cloud environments after go\-live. Our consultants combine functional expertise, collaborative problem\-solving, and proactive client service to improve business processes and the end\-user experience. We value creativity, teamwork, accountability, continuous learning, and a healthy, respectful workplace.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Oracle Cloud EPM Planning
* Manage multiple client workstreams and service priorities concurrently, balancing incidents, service requests, enhancements, recurring activities, and planned initiatives against agreed priorities and service commitments.
* Act as a functional expert as part of a team and/or independently with no supervision.
* Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders. Keep all parties informed about progress, challenges, and changes.
* Collaborate with clients to understand evolving business objectives, operational challenges, and Oracle EPM needs. Assess existing configurations, usage patterns, recurring issues, and business processes to identify opportunities to stabilize, automate, optimize, and improve user adoption.
* Maintain current knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM monthly updates and relevant Oracle roadmap developments. Assess client impact, communicate recommendations, and identify opportunities for optimization and innovation.


**Education**
 MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience, including significant experience supporting and enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud environments after go\-live, with prior full\-lifecycle implementation experience preferred to demonstrate a strong understanding of application design and downstream impacts.
* Expert knowledge of the Oracle Planning Cloud tools required.
* Hands\-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, configuring, or enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud modules such as Workforce, Capital, Projects, Profitability and Cost Management, or Strategic Modeling.
* Strong Essbase calculation script writing skills preferred
* Experience with Groovy Scripts preferred
* Experience with Oracle EPM Data Exchange or Data Management, including troubleshooting data and metadata loads, mappings, integrations, validation failures, and recurring load processes.
* Experience with EDM a plus
* Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud a plus
* Candidate should be teachable with a strong desire to learn and expand current knowledge base
* Professional services experience in an Oracle Cloud EPM Managed Services, application support, or production\-operations role is strongly preferred; experience advising client stakeholders at a strategic level is also beneficial.
* In\-depth knowledge of the relevant technologies and systems.


 SKILL REQUIREMENTS
   

  

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Service Delivery Management: Prioritize and coordinate concurrent client needs across incidents, requests, recurring operations, and enhancements while maintaining clear ownership, realistic commitments, accurate status, and alignment with service levels.
* Continuous Improvement: Translate recurring issues, service trends, Oracle Cloud updates, and industry practices into practical recommendations that improve stability, efficiency, controls, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Strong commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Strong degree of initiative, accuracy, efficiency, and attention to detail.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.


**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
   

  

 Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

* Configure and build CRM migration use cases across platforms such as Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, and other CRM systems.

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you enjoy solving complex business and technology challenges? Are you passionate about helping clients create value through successful integrations and separations?  Then this is the right place for you.

 The Technology M\&A team helps clients navigate the technology implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, joint ventures, and business transformations. * Support business development, proposal creation, thought leadership, and practice growth initiatives.

**Bring Your Best Skills Forward**
* Deep experience leading Technology M\&A engagements including integrations, separations, carve\-outs, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post\-merger integration programs.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage large, complex, global programs with multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting sales, account growth, and client relationship development.
* Ability to translate transaction objectives into actionable technology strategies and execution plans.


**Technology Domain Experience**
 Candidates should possess practical experience in at least one of the following technology domains and understand how these capabilities evolve during M\&A transactions, integrations, and separations:
   

  

* IT Infrastructure \& Cloud
* Infrastructure integration and separation planning.
* Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.
* Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end\-user computing environments.
* Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.
* ERP
* Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP platforms.
* ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve\-out activities.
* Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.
* Enterprise Architecture \& IT Operating Model Transformation
* Enterprise architecture assessments and target\-state design.
* Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.
* IT operating model design and transformation.
* Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.

* Exposure to senior client executives and strategic decision\-making processes.
* Collaboration with leading practitioners across Technology Strategy, M\&A, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Industry groups.
* Personalized training and development programs to strengthen transaction, consulting, and leadership capabilities.

description:
**Job Description**
**About Advance Auto Parts**
 Founded in Roanoke, VA in 1932, Advance Auto Parts is a leading automotive aftermarket retail parts provider that serves both professional installer and do\-it\-yourself Customers. As of July 13, 2019, Advance operated 4,912 stores and 150 Worldpac branches in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The Company also serves 1,250 independently owned CARQUEST branded stores across these locations in addition to Mexico, the Bahamas, Turks, and Caicos and the British Virgin Islands. The company has a workforce of over 70,000 knowledgeable and experienced Team Members who are proud to provide outstanding service to their Customers, Communities, and each other every day.
   

  

**About Advance India Innovation Center (AIIC)**
 We are continually innovating and seeking to elevate the Customer experience at each of our stores. For an organization of our size and reach, today, it has become more critical than ever, to identify synergies and build shared capabilities. The Advance India Innovation Center (AIIC), located in Hyderabad, is a step in this strategic direction that enables us to access a larger talent pool, unlock operational efficiencies and increase levels of collaboration.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Sourcing Advisory Analyst supports the identification, tracking, and analysis of product cost opportunities across the merchandising organization. This role leverages data, analytics, market intelligence, and reporting tools to provide actionable insights that improve product profitability and support sourcing and category management strategies.
   

  

 Working closely with Category Management, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing partners, the Advisory Analyst develops reporting solutions, maintains cost tracking repositories, and conducts analytical assessments of commodity, freight, currency, and vendor cost drivers. This role plays a key part in enabling data\-driven decision making through fact\-based analysis and continuous process improvement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cost Analytics \& Opportunity Identification: Analyze product cost structures, vendor pricing behavior, commodity trends, and sourcing opportunities to identify value creation opportunities and support cost optimization initiatives.
* Reporting \& Dashboard Development: Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and visual analytics that improve visibility into cost change behaviors, savings performance, and sourcing initiatives.
* Data Management \& Governance: Build and manage analytical repositories, cost databases, and tracking mechanisms to ensure accurate historical records of negotiations, sourcing projects, savings initiatives, and business outcomes.
* Business Partner Support: Collaborate with Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, Finance, and cross functional teams to provide analytical support for negotiations, planning activities, and decision\-making processes.
* Market \& Commodity Intelligence: Monitor external market indicators, commodity indices, freight trends, currency movements, and supplier developments to assess potential impacts on product cost and gross margin performance.
* Ad Hoc Analysis: Conduct quantitative analyses and develop management\-ready insights to support special projects, vendor discussions, category reviews, and leadership requests.


**Qualifications**
* Analytical Mindset: Ability to synthesize large datasets into meaningful insights and recommendations that support business decisions.
* Data \& Reporting Skills: Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SQL, or related analytical tools.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to identify trends, uncover root causes, and develop practical business solutions.
* Attention to Detail: Strong commitment to accuracy, data integrity, and quality control.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Ability to effectively communicate insights and partner with stakeholders across multiple functional areas.
* Learning Agility: Intellectual curiosity and willingness to develop expertise in sourcing, commodities, retail economics, and supply chain cost drivers.


**Top Required Skills**
* Results Orientation: Focus on delivering measurable outcomes and value creation.
* Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across teams and functions.
* Continuous Improvement: Seeks opportunities to simplify processes and improve efficiency.


**Experience, And Education**
* Experience: 2\-4 years of experience in analytics, finance, sourcing, merchandising, supply chain, business intelligence, or a related field.
* Education: Masters in Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related discipline; OR equivalent combination of education and experience.

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI\-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
   

  

 We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
   

  

 Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM \+ AI conversation \- shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
* You will lead India Presales and a team of \~10\-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid\-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.


**What Work Looks Like**
* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO\-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10\-15\-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution\-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI\-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI\-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time


**Role expectations**
* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.
* Raise the talent bar. Build a high\-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.
* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.
* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 12–15\+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.
* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross\-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.


**Why this role is different**
 You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.
   

  

**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Tech Modernization – Senior Manager
description:
**Technology Strategy and Transformation – Senior Manager – Technology Modernization**
 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients define and accelerate technology modernization journeys that unlock growth, simplify complexity and create future\-ready technology landscapes

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growth? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choices? Do you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
   

  

 If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategies, target\-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C\-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business\-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.
   

  

 We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep\-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end\-to\-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high\-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:
   

  

**Modernization Strategy \& Value Agenda:** 
 Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes
 **Technology Estate \& Application Portfolio Assessment:** 
 Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non\-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio\-level priorities
 **Target Architecture \& Modernization Pathways:** 
 Shape target\-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation
 **Modernization Roadmap, Business Case \& Decision Governance:** 
 Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade\-offs and realize measurable business value
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy \& Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization\-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.
   

  

 The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.
   

  

 The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade\-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long\-term architecture fit.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap**
* Lead enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes
* Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business\-aligned technology modernization priorities
* Assess current\-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems
* Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools
* Shape target\-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction
* Define modernization guiding principles, decision \& prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices
* Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners
* Build multi\-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness
* Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed\-to\-market


**Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture \& Planning**
* Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential
* Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities
* Define application modernization pathways for target applications
* Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options
* Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies
* Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity
* Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API\-led integration, microservices, event\-driven architecture, cloud\-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform\-based modernization
* Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future\-ready application architecture
* Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


**Executive advisory and Growth**
* Lead CxO\-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade\-offs and enterprise transformation decisions
* Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions
* Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership\-ready points of view
* Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive\-ready solution narratives
* Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client
* Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks
* Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


**Core Skillsets \& Tools**
**Technology Modernization Advisory**
* Strong understanding of how enterprise technology modernization enables business growth, agility, resilience, cost optimization, speed\-to\-market and technology simplification
* Ability to assess complex technology estates across applications, platforms, integrations, data dependencies, AI, engineering, infrastructure touchpoints, cloud footprint, vendor ecosystem and technology debt
* Strong capability in legacy application modernization, technology debt assessment, modernization prioritization and investment sequencing across large enterprise landscapes
* Experience in developing modernization value cases that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes such as run\-cost reduction, risk reduction, improved resilience, faster change velocity and business capability enablement
* Familiarity operating model implications of modernization, including product\-centric delivery, platform operating models, engineering maturity, governance and change readiness
* Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise value chain


**Application Architecture, Engineering and AI**
* Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data \& AI architecture, cloud architecture and transition architecture in modernization contexts
* Deep understanding of modern application architecture patterns such as domain\-driven design, modular architecture, microservices, event\-driven architecture, API\-led integration, cloud\-native application design and strangler\-based modernization
* Strong understanding of application modernization pathways including trade\-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity
* Experience with aging application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end\-of\-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes
* Practical understanding of modern engineering practices such as AI driven SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, Kubernetes and platform engineering
* Strong understanding of frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, COBIT, IT4IT, business capability modelling, modernization maturity assessment and technology value assessment
* Good understanding of cloud, data and AI architecture concepts, including Azure/AWS/GCP, data lake, data fabric, real\-time data processing, semantic models, AI/ML integration, GenAI enablement and AI\-ready application architecture
* Familiarity with platform ecosystems across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, hyperscalers, integration platforms, data platforms, observability tools and engineering toolchains


**Consulting And Communication Skills**
* Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, assessment design, facilitation, business case development and executive storytelling
* Ability to engage senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity, influence client leadership and create alignment across business and technology teams
* Experience in independently leading client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling modernization narratives and shape opportunities
* Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits and senior client relationship development


**Read More About Us.**
* The rise of forerunners
* Recent Blogs


**What’s in it for you?**
* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting:**
 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in\-country teams to deliver cutting\-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network
   

  

 Accenture Capability Network \| Accenture in One Word
   

  

 At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high\-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
   

  

 You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent\-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands\-on builder, deep product architect, and first\-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain\-Specific AI Integration**
 Architect Intent\-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high\-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
   

  

 Context\-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain\-specific Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
   

  

 Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core\-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
   

  

**Product Delivery \& SDLC Acceleration**
 Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain\-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
   

  

 Establish Guardrails \& AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human\-in\-the\-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2\).
   

  

 Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature\-to\-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge\-case test generation.
   

  

**Forward\-Deployed Customer Engagement**
 Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
   

  

 Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high\-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
   

  

 Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C\-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Must\-Have Qualifications And Experience**
 Experience: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5\+ years spent delivering high\-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
   

  

 Technical Fluency: Deep, hands\-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE\-based assistants.
   

  

 Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
   

  

 Background in customer\-facing technical roles such as Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:**

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist, Procurement and Category Management**
 The Analyst will be responsible for developing and supporting key internal stakeholder and external supplier relationships in a variety of procurement categories, including contracting support in the areas of Talent\- contingent Labor program
   

  

 This position is an opportunity to play an active role in the selection and management of highly visible and critical service providers.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Specialist, Procurement and Category Management in the team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Serving as a procurement advisor to internal stakeholders by supporting sourcing, contracting, and supplier management activities for Talent and contingent labor categories
* Managing the end\-to\-end Statement of Work (SOW) lifecycle, including review, routing, approvals, execution, renewals, expirations, scope changes, and contract record maintenance
* Conducting market research, spend analysis, and supplier assessments to identify sourcing opportunities, support category strategies, and improve procurement outcomes
* Coordinating with business stakeholders, internal teams, and suppliers to gather requirements, resolve contracting and invoicing issues, and support supplier performance management

More specifically, EA enables the business units to solely focus on satisfying clients and developing new products and services to sustain competitive advantage, while they consolidate and standardize a diverse collection of systems, processes, and functions. The team provides a wide array of services to the U.S and India professionals and is continually evaluating and expanding its portfolio.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM; flexibility in shift timing is required**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 3\-5 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or contract negotiation
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* Experience supporting contingent labor, recruitment services, or Talent procurement activities
* Experience managing Statements of Work (SOWs), contract renewals, or supplier agreements
* Experience working in a matrixed corporate environment
* Experience using SAP Fieldglass, SAP Ariba, or similar procurement systems

 Preferred:

title: Presales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ankura Homes is dedicated to creating living spaces that support a dynamic, family\-centered lifestyle and personal growth. The company designs communities where residents can enjoy a vibrant environment, meaningful connections, and a fulfilling way of life. With a strong emphasis on innovative residential options, Ankura Homes aims to offer attractive choices for individuals and families seeking a modern, engaging lifestyle. Applicants can expect to join a team that values creativity, community, and long\-term resident well\-being.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Presales Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for driving pre\-sales activities that support the company’s residential offerings. This role involves engaging prospective buyers, understanding their needs, and presenting tailored housing solutions through consultations, presentations, and site visits. The Presales Manager will prepare proposals, coordinate with sales and project teams, and support integration of customer requirements into project plans. Daily responsibilities include managing lead pipelines, conducting product demonstrations, responding to inquiries, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth transition from presales to sales closure. The role also requires maintaining accurate documentation, tracking metrics, and providing feedback to improve offerings and customer experience.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Consulting and Presales skills to understand customer requirements and propose suitable solutions.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales experience, including lead management, presentations, and supporting deal closure.
* Candidates should possess Project Management capabilities to coordinate timelines, resources, and customer expectations.
* Candidates should possess Integration skills to align customer needs with Ankura Homes’ product and service offerings.
* Relevant experience in real estate, housing, or lifestyle communities is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally and build trust with prospective customers.
* Ability to work on\-site in Hyderabad, manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, and use CRM or similar tools for tracking presales activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Proposal Coordinator
description:
**About RADISE India Pvt Ltd** 


 RADISE India is a dynamic and exciting place to work with a focus on smart infrastructure. RADISE India is part of an ecosystem of companies — RADISE INTERNATIONAL, Smart Structures, Applied Foundation Testing, CRAIG A SMITH \& ASSOCIATES, and ETAGRA Inc — that together form the SMART INFRASTRUCTURE GROUP (SIG): a $50M organization with 350\+ employees, growing steadily. Our clients span Transportation, Waste Water, Ports, High\-Rise Buildings, Bridges, Tunnels, and Power Plants.
 




  




**About the Role** 


 RADISE India is seeking a versatile Proposal \& Market Research Coordinator to join our Hyderabad team. This role blends market/bid research with proposal coordination and writing, supporting our Engineering \& IT Staffing proposals for US Federal, SLED opportunities. The ideal candidate can identify and track bidding opportunities, maintain CRM data, and then carry those opportunities through to compliant, well\-written, and professionally packaged proposals.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities**

 Market Research \& Bid Identification
 


 •      Identify and Analyze U.S. Federal, SLED RFPs, RFQs, and task orders, especially those related to Engineering, IT Staffing, instrumentation, sensor\-based monitoring systems, data management solutions, and other smart infrastructure initiatives.
 





 •      Monitor changes in advertisement dates, addenda, and award notifications; keep CRM/ERP records current and accurate.
 





 •      Conduct primary and secondary research using data collection methods such as polls, focus groups, and surveys.
 





 •      Apply working knowledge of data warehousing and mining to support opportunity tracking and reporting.
 





 •      Generate weekly/monthly pipeline and research reports; participate in sales/BD meetings.
 





 •      Apply knowledge of the US Procurement process to prioritize and qualify opportunities.
 




  





  





 Proposal Coordination \& Writing

title: Growth Specialist
description:
Growth Specialist — Sales \& Partnerships
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Employment type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: Exceptional final\-year students, recent graduates and early\-career candidates are welcome to apply.
 



 About Nextrap
 



 Nextrap is an analytics\-focused wearable and health technology company being built for India. Our first product combines a screenless smart band with a companion app that helps people understand sleep, recovery, activity, heart\-rate trends and the choices that shape their health.
 



 We are not looking to build just another gadget. We want to make health data genuinely useful, beautiful and actionable.
 



 The role
 



 This is not a narrow sales role and it is not a conventional marketing internship. You will be Nextrap’s first employee, working directly with the founder to help take an early wearable brand from product to real customer love, partnerships and revenue.
 



 You will speak to customers, sell the product, build early partnerships, run growth experiments, create sharp content, and bring back the honest insights that improve the product and brand.
 



 What you will own
 


* Turn early interest into sales through thoughtful outreach, product demos, follow\-ups and customer conversations.
* Build relationships with gyms, sports clubs, coaches, athletes, wellness communities, creators and relevant B2B partners.
* Represent Nextrap at events, activations and in\-person meetings.
* Run practical growth experiments across social media, WhatsApp, communities, partnerships and offline channels.
* Help shape customer\-facing messaging, sales collateral and product demos.
* Maintain a clean lead pipeline and clearly report what customers are asking for.
* Collect customer feedback and turn it into useful product and positioning insights.
* Take ownership of the work needed to move an early\-stage company forward.



 You may be a great fit if you
 


* Communicate with clarity, energy and empathy.
* Can confidently sell both a physical product and a software experience.
* Are proactive and follow through without needing every step defined.
* Care about fitness, health, technology, design or consumer brands.
* Are comfortable with rejection, ambiguity and fast iteration.
* Can write crisp messages, make a good presentation and hold an engaging product conversation.



 We would especially love to hear from people who actively
 **play sports** 
 or have competed at a high level. First\-hand experience of training, recovery and performance gives you a real advantage in understanding the product, discovering useful insights and speaking credibly with our early customers. This is a preference, not a requirement.
 



 Prior startup, consumer\-tech, fitness, sports, campus\-community, retail, sales, creator or partnership experience is useful, but not mandatory. We care more about hunger, judgment, communication and ownership than a perfect résumé.
 



**Compensation:** 

 ₹3\.0–3\.6 LPA CTC, depending on experience, demonstrated ability and fit for the role.
 




 How to apply
 



 Send your résumé and a short note answering: How would you convince a health\-conscious Indian customer to try a screenless smart band from a new brand?
 



 Also share:
 


* One example of something you have sold, grown, organised or built—at college, work or independently.
* Your sport or fitness background, if applicable, and one health or performance insight you would want a wearable to help you understand.
* One piece of honest advice you would give Nextrap as an early\-stage wearable brand.

title: Data and AI Security Consultant
description:
**Overview**
 The EAG Security Consultant \- Data Security helps enterprise customers discover, classify, protect, govern, and investigate sensitive data across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Purview, endpoints, cloud services, and AI\-enabled workflows. The role combines hands\-on Purview delivery, consulting judgment, regulatory awareness, and secure AI adoption patterns to reduce data exposure risk, strengthen DLP effectiveness, prepare customers for Copilot and agents, and create reusable EAG Security delivery IP.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead data security discovery workshops to understand sensitive data landscape, regulatory drivers, current Purview adoption, oversharing risks, and AI / Copilot readiness blockers.
* Design and implement Microsoft Purview Information Protection capabilities including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto\-labeling patterns, and user adoption controls.
* Configure, tune, and operationalize Data Loss Prevention across Microsoft 365 workloads, endpoints, cloud apps, browsers, and AI\-related workflows where applicable.
* Assess Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, Data Lifecycle Management, and Compliance Manager usage to improve investigation readiness and governance maturity.
* Apply DSPM and data\-security\-for\-AI patterns to identify overshared sensitive data, label coverage gaps, exposed credentials, and risky data interactions before AI rollout.
* Support Data Protection Agents and Purview agent scenarios such as sensitive data discovery, SIT recommendation, DLP triage, Purview posture assessment, and regulatory mapping.
* Create executive\-ready deliverables including posture baselines, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, policy design packs, operating procedures, and adoption recommendations.
* Contribute reusable EAG Security IP, lab guides, demos, accelerators, playbooks, and enablement content for data security delivery at scale.


**Qualifications**
 Required/Minimum Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information protection, data loss prevention, compliance engineering, data governance, or related security consulting roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview data security capabilities, especially Information Protection and Data Loss Prevention in Microsoft 365 environments.
* Working knowledge of sensitive information types, classification strategies, sensitivity labels, DLP rules, alert triage, policy tuning, and exception handling.
* Ability to translate regulatory, privacy, and business requirements into implementable Microsoft Purview controls and customer\-facing design documentation.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance workloads including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, endpoints, Defender for Cloud Apps, audit and eDiscovery signals.
* Ability to analyze policy exports, telemetry, PowerShell outputs, and Purview reports to identify coverage gaps and remediation priorities.
* Strong communication skills for technical workshops, executive readouts, project governance, and cross\-functional collaboration with security, compliance, legal, and data teams.


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering Purview deployments for regulated customers across DLP, MIP, IRM, retention, eDiscovery, audit, or Copilot readiness scenarios.
* Exposure to Data Protection Agents, Purview posture assessment, custom SIT discovery, DLP triage agents, DSPM, DSPM for AI, or Security Copilot in Microsoft Purview.
* Ability to design custom sensitive information types, regex\-based detection logic, policy coverage assessments, and evidence\-backed compliance mappings.
* Familiarity with data security beyond Microsoft 365, including Azure, Fabric, Snowflake, Dataverse, SAP, Salesforce, AWS, GCP, SaaS, or file\-server governance patterns.
* Experience creating reusable consulting IP such as discovery questionnaires, policy design templates, lab guides, dashboards, scripts, reports, and executive summaries.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

* Conduct thorough techno\-commercial evaluation of client requirements, RFQs, and tender documents.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (mandatory).

* Strong experience in techno\-commercial proposal preparation and design review.
* Proficiency in engineering design and visualization software.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.



**PREFERRED BACKGROUND** 



* Experience in Oil \& Gas, Power Substations, Plants, Refineries, or similar critical infrastructure, ABB, Siemens, Schneider, GE, Toshiba etc

* Knowledge of Condition Based Monitoring tools, sensors, and data\-driven asset health frameworks.

We are looking for a result\-driven Sales Manager to manage residential property sales, handle client requirements, conduct site visits, and close deals. The role involves guiding clients through the complete buying journey—from inquiry to final closure—while achieving sales targets.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 Client Handling \& Requirement Understanding
 


* Handle client inquiries and assigned leads for residential properties
* Understand client needs including budget, location, and preferences
* Recommend suitable property options



  





 Site Visits \& Property Presentation
 


* Conduct site visits for residential projects
* Present property features, pricing, and project details clearly
* Assist clients in property selection



  





 Sales \& Deal Closure
 


* Negotiate pricing and terms with clients
* Follow up regularly to convert leads into closures
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets



  





 Relationship Management
 


* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients
* Ensure high customer satisfaction throughout the sales process
* Generate repeat business and referrals



  





 Market Knowledge
 


* Stay updated on residential real estate trends and pricing
* Monitor competitor projects and market dynamics



  





 Documentation \& Coordination
 


* Assist in booking, documentation, and agreement process
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth transaction closure
* Maintain accurate client records and reports\\



  





 Requirements:
 


* 2–5 years of experience in residential real estate sales
* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Experience in handling end\-to\-end property sales
* Target\-driven and result\-oriented mindset
* Good understanding of the local real estate market



  





 Salary \- 4,20,000 \- 8,40,000
 



  





 Skills Required:
 


* Sales \& closing skills
* Client relationship management
* Negotiation skills
* Presentation skills
* Time management



  





 Education:
 


* Bachelor’s Degree (Mandatory)
* MBA in Sales/Marketing (Preferred)

**About The Company**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our global team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD. **Introduction to the Division /Function**
 The Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) provides advanced products that support materials science research and development, helping customers drive innovation and improve productivity. Our portfolio includes scientific instruments for designing, characterizing, and scaling materials from the laboratory to production. CAD consists of three main business units:
 **Measurement Control \& Sample Identification (MCS)** 
 ,
 **Environmental \& Process Monitoring (EPM)** 
 , and
 **Production, Process \& Analytics (PPA)** 
 . The MCS business unit includes
 **Molecular Spectroscopy (MOL)** 
 and
 **Field \& Safety Instruments (FSI)** 
 .

 portfolio, including

 systems

Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.

 Architecture Design and Deployment

Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood.

Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues.
