Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
   

  

 Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry\-wide direction for specific architecture(s).
   

  

 Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.

 At least 12\-14\+ years related IT experience with Solution Architecture having experience in enterprise\-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.
   

  

 Work experience should involve pre\-sales support on large deals in technical consulting, solution design of complex solutions, project envisioning, planning, development, deployment, and Team management.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300057
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 Experience: 12\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

description:
*****About Kennametal*****
*With over 80 years as an industrial technology leader, Kennametal Inc. delivers productivity to customers through materials science, tooling and wear\-resistant solutions. Customers across aerospace and defense, earthworks, energy, general engineering and transportation turn to Kennametal to help them manufacture with precision and efficiency. *www.kennametal.com* 
*. Follow @Kennametal: Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.*
****Job Summary****
 Describe the purpose of the job:
   

  

* To drive new sales and retain key accounts in the assigned territory by providing technical and field support for Tungsten Carbide wear parts used in Rotary Drilling and DTH applications within the mining industry.
* Expand Kennametal offerings beyond India by adding new customers and increasing share of wallet through successful product trials


****Key Job Responsibilities****
* Manage key accounts within the assigned territory; role based in Hyderabad.
* Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue and margin targets.
* Demonstrate strong application knowledge and technical capabilities to support customers.
* Promote Tungsten Carbide compacts for Rotary Drilling and DTH applications and manage high\-volume accounts.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities; lead negotiations and finalize long\-term contracts.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Plant, R\&D, Engineering and Finance.
* Apply industry knowledge, data analysis skills and strong account management to drive growth in a fast\-paced environment.
* Assess customer needs and develop appropriate sales strategies.
* Drive YOY sales growth and new business development within assigned accounts.
* Support team sales initiatives by sharing relevant customer and market information.
* Utilize CRM tools (MS Dynamics) for account and sales management.
* Conduct field trials, resolve customer complaints, gather competitive intelligence, and deliver product seminars/training.
* Perform complex analyses and provide recommendations to support business objectives.
* Prepare regular progress, status and forecast reports.
* Manage receivables effectively and maintain required DSO.


****Education, Work Experience, Skills, Certificates****
 Necessary to perform the job at the minimum acceptable level and preferred:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or industrial engineering; MBA preferred.
* 10–15 years of experience in sales, key account management, industrial sales, and wear products, including experience working with mining customers for Tungsten Carbide Compacts, PTA powders, and HF rods.
* Strong value\-selling capabilities with a winning and growth\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to understand and communicate product and technical information effectively to customers.
* Proven ability to assess customer needs, conduct trials at customer sites, and generate detailed trial reports.
* Demonstrated selling and negotiation skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (over 70%).

title: Technical Consultant-Identity & Access Management
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Technical Consultant specializing in Identity \& Access Management, you possess extensive experience and expertise in various IAM solutions, product suites, and downstream applications. You leverage in\-depth product knowledge, client business understanding, and IAM solution expertise to deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement IAM Solutions: Deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs, ensuring a least privilege model and implementing single sign\-on solutions.
* Provide Consulting Services: Analyze and resolve IAM issues and provide consulting services to integrate IAM application services with broader application portfolios.
* Advise Clients: Advise clients on the selection, implementation, customization, configuration, and production support of IAM security tools and solutions.
* Deliver End\-to\-End Solutions: Provide end\-to\-end user life cycle provisioning, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
* Resolve IAM Issues: Analyze and resolve IAM issues, contributing to an overall superior security posture for the client.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* IAM Solution Expertise: Exposure to various IAM solutions, product suites, and downstream applications, with the ability to deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs.
* Product Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of IAM products, including configuration, customization, and production support, to advise clients on selecting and implementing IAM security tools and solutions.
* End\-to\-End Provisioning: Experience working with end\-to\-end user life cycle provisioning, ensuring a least privilege model and implementing single sign\-on solutions.
* Issue Resolution: Exposure to analyzing and resolving IAM issues, with the ability to provide consulting services to integrate IAM application services with broader application portfolios.
* Client Business Understanding: Understanding of client business needs, with the ability to leverage this knowledge to deliver tailored IAM solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Downstream Application Knowledge: Exposure to various downstream applications, with the ability to integrate IAM solutions seamlessly. This includes understanding how to configure and customize these applications to meet clients' diverse business needs.
* Advanced IAM Product Suites: Experience working with multiple IAM product suites, including in\-depth knowledge of their features and capabilities. This enables providing high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' specific requirements.
* Security Posture Enhancement: Exposure to analyzing and resolving IAM issues, with the ability to provide consulting services that enhance the overall security posture for clients. This includes identifying vulnerabilities and implementing measures to mitigate risks.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. title: Forward deployed engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect \- Deccan AI
 



**About** 
 :
 



 Deccan AI is a venture\-backed AI infrastructure company ($25M Series A, Prosus Ventures), headquartered in the Bay Area with an engineering hub in Hyderabad. We build the infrastructure layer for Reinforcement Learning and Agentic AI and work with frontier labs including Google DeepMind and Snowflake.
 



  





 Deccan AI builds the data, evaluation, and agentic infrastructure that helps frontier labs and enterprises ship AI that actually works in production. Our Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms put humans and AI side by side to catch failures, close evaluation gaps, and run mission\-critical workflows. As we move from data and evals into full\-scale enterprise deployments, we're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect to sit at the center of that motion: embedded with customers, owning the technical relationship, and turning ambiguous problems into shipped, reliable AI systems.
 



  





 This is a customer\-facing, build\-heavy role. You will spend as much time in a client's codebase and infrastructure as you do in a whiteboard session with their VP of Engineering. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture and writing the code that proves it out.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Embed directly with enterprise customers to scope, design, and build production AI solutions on top of Deccan AI's Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms.
* Own the end\-to\-end technical relationship for key accounts: requirements gathering, solution architecture, implementation, deployment, and post\-launch iteration.
* Translate ambiguous, often messy customer workflows into concrete technical designs data pipelines, agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, and integration points with the customer's existing infra.
* Write production\-grade code alongside customer engineering teams; this is not a slideware role.
* Build reusable patterns, tooling, and accelerators from each engagement so the next deployment moves faster than the last.
* Act as the technical voice of the customer internally feeding field learnings back into product and platform roadmaps.
* Debug and resolve issues in live, high\-stakes deployments, often under time pressure and with imperfect information.
* Present architecture, tradeoffs, and rollout plans to both engineering counterparts and executive stakeholders.



**What we're looking for** 



* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a forward\-deployed / professional\-services engineering role, ideally with exposure to AI, ML, or data\-intensive systems.
* Strong hands\-on coding ability (Python and/or a modern backend language) you can prototype, productionize, and debug your own work, not just review someone else's.
* Experience designing and deploying systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including data pipelines and API\-level integrations.
* Working knowledge of LLM\-based systems: prompting, evaluation, RAG, agentic workflows, or fine\-tuning you don't need to have built a foundation model, but you need to have shipped something that uses one.
* Excellent communication skills you can move fluidly between a technical deep\-dive with engineers and a business conversation with a customer sponsor.
* A bias toward ownership: comfortable being the one person accountable for a customer's technical outcome, without a large team behind you at every step.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed and to work occasionally across customer time zones.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Prior experience in a forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role at an AI/ML or enterprise software company.
* Experience building or operating evaluation systems for AI agents or LLM applications.
* Familiarity with human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and production monitoring for AI systems.
* Startup experience, particularly in a 0\-to\-1 or early\-scale environment.



  





**Why Deccan AI** 



* Work at the point where AI research meets real enterprise deployment your work ships to production, not to a slide.
* High\-trust, high\-ownership culture: capable people who move fast and hold a high bar.
* Direct exposure to frontier AI labs and enterprise customers solving genuinely hard problems.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a seat at the table as the company scales.

title: Interior Design Consultant
description:
WE’RE HIRING Interior Design Consultant
 



 Studio Scintilla \| Powered by Craftsville
 



 📍 Gachibowli, Hyderabad \| Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





 Design. Consult. Convert.
 



 Studio Scintilla is an end\-to\-end interior design and execution studio, established in 2016 and powered by Craftsville, our own in\-house modular factory.
 



 With 150\+ homes delivered, we create bespoke residential interiors from modular kitchens and wardrobes to complete home transformations backed by our in\-house 3D design and execution capabilities.
 



 We’re looking for an Interior Design Consultant who can bring together design understanding, client relationship skills, and a strong sales mindset.
 



  





 YOUR ROLE
 



 You’ll be the face of Studio Scintilla for prospective clients taking them from their first conversation to a signed project.
 



 You’ll understand their lifestyle and requirements, translate their ideas into a clear design direction, present concepts and materials, discuss budgets, prepare proposals, negotiate, and close.
 



  





 WHAT YOU’LL OWN
 



 Client Consultation
 



 • Manage clients from first inquiry through the sales process
 



 • Understand lifestyle, requirements, preferences, and budgets
 



 • Develop clear design briefs and manage client communication
 



 • Build trust and confidently guide clients through decisions
 



 Design \& Presentations
 



 • Create compelling mood boards and client presentations
 



 • Present portfolios, executed projects, concepts, and material options
 



 • Tailor presentations to make each client's vision feel personal and tangible
 



 Sales \& Commercial
 



 • Own the sales cycle — follow\-up → consultation → proposal → negotiation → closing
 



 • Prepare accurate quotations and budget proposals
 



 • Handle objections around budget, design, and timelines
 



 • Work towards individual and team sales targets
 



 Collaboration
 



 • Work closely with design, 3D, catalogue, execution, sales, and marketing teams
 



 • Ensure client requirements and quotations are realistic and deliverable
 



 • Bring client feedback and market insights back to the team
 



  





 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 



 • Strong understanding of interior design, styles, materials, and residential interiors
 



 • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
 



 • Experience creating mood boards, presentations, or proposals
 



 • Understanding of quotations, budgeting, and project scope
 



 • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and closing skills
 



 • Ability to qualify leads and manage follow\-ups/pipeline
 



 • Basic knowledge of Canva, PowerPoint, Keynote, or similar tools
 



 • Working knowledge of CRM or sales tracking tools
 



 • Understanding of the interior design/execution process
 



 • Comfortable with client meetings and site visits
 



 • Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and professional
 



  





 EXPERIENCE
 



 1–3 years of experience in:
 



 • Interior design sales / consulting
 



 • Real estate sales
 



 • Furniture / modular interiors
 



 • High\-ticket B2C sales
 



 A Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
 



 Prior experience in interior design, modular furniture, or real estate is strongly preferred.
 



 Candidates from strong sales backgrounds with a genuine understanding of interiors are also encouraged to apply.
 



  





 WHY STUDIO SCINTILLA?
 



 150\+ homes delivered.
 



 In\-house 3D design.
 



 In\-house execution.
 



 Powered by Craftsville.
 



 Join a team where you’ll have real ownership, real client interaction, and a direct impact on revenue and the client experience without the outsourcing gaps between design and execution.
 



  





 READY TO JOIN US?
 


* 📩 To apply: Send your portfolio/resume to team@scintillainterio.in or DM us directly.

title: Field Account Manager
description:
The Sales Account Manager will be responsible for all sales results of mid\-size and large accounts in a defined territory and for developing strong customer relations according to the organizational strategy for the assigned customer base. An essential part of this role is the active use of our CRM system (SFDC) to manage sales activities and customer interactions effectively as this tool is the foundation of our sales framework and operational sales steering, and a key enabler for this role to achieve his/her targets as well as Sartorius targets.
   

  

 The Sales Account Manager will be responsible for all sales results of mid\-size and large accounts in a defined territory and for developing strong customer relations according to the organizational strategy for the assigned customer base. An essential part of this role is the active use of our CRM system (SFDC) to manage sales activities and customer interactions effectively as this tool is the foundation of our sales framework and operational sales steering, and a key enabler for this role to achieve his/her targets as well as Sartorius targets.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities \& Tasks**
* Promote the organization's products and services within an assigned geographic area, product range or key account to achieve sales and revenue targets
* Identify new business opportunities aligned with the organization's overall market and growth strategy
* Actively use SFDC to manage and document leads and opportunities, all customer interactions and sales activities ensuring that all customer and opportunity information is up\-to\-date and accurately entered in the CRM system
* Analyze SFDC data for assigned customers to identify trends, generate customer insights and track sales performance
* Actively drive newly launched innovative products and services into the marketplace and proactively follow up on the successful implementation of sales activity
* Assess and analyze customer needs, generate leads, respond to customer inquiries and suggest products and services as appropriate
* Develop and implement account plans and request and coordinate resources in line with the account plans
* Work closely with cross functional team to create higher market perception and successful strategies to gain business from an account
* Coordinate and participate in marketing activities in assigned territory
* Frequently assess the potential of each customer and plan to realize it into business
* Manage and build strong customer relationships for long term partnership

* Master degree in life sciences or engineering (higher level of education would be beneficial)
* Minimum 5\-8 years field sales experience, with preferable laboratory / process based experience in Life Science
* Hands\-on knowledge and proactive usage of SFDC and other CRM tools
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Self\-motivated, energetic, results oriented, capacity to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility
* Good teamwork skills and proven ability to also work with cross\-functional teams

title: Supplier Enablement Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 The R2P Supplier Enablement Sr Analyst role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end supplier enablement and digital transaction adoption across the enterprise within the Requisition\-to\-Pay (R2P) Operations \& Support organization. This role owns supplier onboarding, SAP Ariba Network enablement, enterprise licensing adoption, transaction readiness, and supplier success outcomes, ensuring suppliers can transact digitally through approved platforms in a timely, compliant, and sustainable manner. The role acts as both a project lead and trusted advisor to suppliers and internal stakeholders, leveraging techno\-functional expertise to accelerate adoption, resolve complex challenges, and maximize business value realization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Supplier Onboarding \& Transaction Enablement
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end supplier onboarding and enablement activities, including registration, account strategy assessment, supplier segmentation, Enterprise Account enablement, catalog readiness, transaction configuration, and compliance validation to support digital commerce objectives. (Executes)
* Drive SAP Ariba Network enablement and enterprise licensing adoption, educating suppliers on platform capabilities, account structures, subscription options, transaction requirements, and best practices to maximize platform utilization and business value. (Executes)
* Manage supplier enablement engagements as structured projects with defined timelines, deliverables, success criteria, stakeholder communication plans, and adoption milestones. (Owns)
* Perform techno\-functional assessments of supplier capabilities and transaction readiness, identifying integration, configuration, process, and operational gaps that may impact electronic transaction adoption. (Executes)
* Partner with suppliers, SAP Ariba support teams, integration teams, and internal stakeholders to resolve onboarding, connectivity, invoicing, catalog, purchase order, and transaction processing challenges. (Executes)
* Ensure supplier enablement activities adhere to enterprise compliance, risk management, master data governance, security, and system control requirements, escalating exceptions and risks as necessary. (Owns)


 Supplier Support \& Issue Resolution
   

  

* Act as the primary point of accountability for supplier enablement success, monitoring supplier progress from onboarding through steady\-state adoption and transaction compliance. (Owns)
* Establish and track supplier adoption metrics including transaction volume, invoice compliance, electronic invoicing utilization, catalog adoption, PO automation rates, and overall network engagement. (Executes)
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, transaction failures, process inefficiencies, and supplier experience challenges, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. (Owns)
* Engage directly with supplier leadership and operational teams to drive issue resolution, adoption acceleration, and long\-term supplier success. (Executes)
* Manage escalations involving complex business, operational, integration, configuration, or system\-related issues, coordinating resolution across SAP Ariba, Procurement, Finance, IT, and Governance teams. (Leads)
* Provide consultation and guidance on SAP Ariba functionality, transaction troubleshooting, best practices, and process optimization opportunities. (Consulted)


 Documentation, Adoption \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Maintain supplier\-facing documentation, training materials, enablement playbooks, process guides, and knowledge repositories to support scalable global enablement efforts. (Owns)
* Analyze supplier enablement performance, transaction adoption trends, operational metrics, and recurring issues to identify root causes and drive sustainable improvements. (Executes)
* Create adoption dashboards, supplier success scorecards, project status reporting, and executive\-level insights to support governance and decision\-making. (Executes)
* Recommend process enhancements, automation opportunities, and platform optimization initiatives to improve supplier experience, operational efficiency, and compliance outcomes. (Consulted / Leads)
* Support enterprise supplier migration initiatives, digital transformation programs, and SAP Ariba capability expansion projects, ensuring successful supplier adoption and change management. (Executes)


 Collaboration \& Governance Alignment
   

  

* Partner with Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, Finance, IT, Master Data, Risk, Compliance, SAP Ariba, and Governance teams to develop and execute supplier enablement strategies aligned with enterprise objectives. (Consulted / Executes)
* Influence supplier and stakeholder decision\-making through data\-driven recommendations, adoption insights, and subject matter expertise in supplier enablement and SAP Ariba processes. (Executes)
* Participate in governance forums, operational reviews, supplier performance discussions, and transformation initiatives to ensure alignment with business priorities and digital procurement goals. (Consulted)
* Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for supplier enablement strategy, enterprise licensing adoption, supplier experience, and SAP Ariba operational excellence initiatives. (Owns)


**Qualifications**
* 9\-11 years of experience in supplier enablement or procurement operations, with exposure to downstream AP operations within a shared services or global delivery environment
* Hands\-on experience supporting supplier onboarding or transaction enablement in SAP environments
* Experience working in a global or multi\-regional operating model

title: Lakehouse Data Products Solution Owner
description:
Through STEP (Sandoz Transformation Enterprise Program), we are creating a unified, integrated digital core and simplifying our end\-to\-end ways of working. From SAP S/4HANA to Veeva, Workday, LabVantage, and beyond, you’ll help design and deliver future\-ready systems that drive global impact — enabling us to deliver affordable medicines to more patients worldwide.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) platform and related platform components, ensuring they effectively meet evolving business needs, perform optimally, and are regularly improved to support strategic objectives and innovation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Act as the central point of contact for all SAP BDC functionality, ensuring continuous alignment with business strategies and process requirements.
* Manage the entire lifecycle of the SAP BDC system, overseeing scheduled upgrades, patch management, and version control through SAP's Software Update Manager (SUM) or similar tools.
* Partner with other IT teams working on BDC components like Datasphere or SAC to translate requirements into SAP BDC configurations
* Identify and implement SAP Data Products, Insight apps or enhancements to improve user experience and increase productivity, ensuring the BDC platform supports emerging business needs.
* Define and oversee platform solution architecture standards and development guidelines and perform implementation reviews to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Analyze technical as well as data requirements and translate them into functional specifications for implementation in close alignment with enterprise archtecture standards
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless business solution implementations and integrations with other platforms (e.g., Databricks), ensuring that SAP BDC acts as the central hub for reporting \& analytics on SAP data.
* Analyze technical as well as data requirements and translate them into functional specifications for implementation of custom data products
* Manage relationships with SAP and third\-party service providers, ensuring that SAP BDC service levels and support or customizations meet technical, business and compliance requirements
* Coordinate with SAP for procurement decisions related to credit consumption, additional licenses, modules, or software that enhance the capabilities of the existing SAP BDC landscape
* Ensure proper change \& release management processes on the platform to control deployments Effective user training is in place to provide on\-demand learning and support.
* Engage and manage stakeholders, fostering collaboration and alignment.
* Ensure SAP BDC meets the organization’s security requirements, including securing user roles and access control using SAP Identity Management (IdM) or SAP GRC.
* Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support compliance audits, leveraging SAP's audit logging capabilities and tracking of system changes to ensure data integrity


**Minimum Requirements**
 What you’ll bring to the role:
   

  

* Strong understanding of SAP related data management and governance principles
* Extensive knowledge of SAP technologies (BDC, SAC, BTP, BW) with a proven track record of successful implementation and integration in the data analytics area
* Understanding of main Technology feature supporting data management and analytic
* Technical leadership role model for delivering of POVs/POCs and to oversee the development of data platform features
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills to address complex data challenges.
* Ability to align SAP BDC data solutions with business objectives and deliver measurable value


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related business field; (Master’s degree is preferred)


**Languages**
 English
   

  

**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**

* Ability to demonstrate and explain correct operation of equipment
* Understanding of good laboratory practices and techniques

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Healthcare - 6+ Years - immediate joiners only
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) \- Healthcare MarTech** 




 The Forward Deployed Engineer is a business\-facing, hands\-on product and engineering role. The FDE works directly with healthcare marketing stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape practical solutions and create working evidence quickly.
 



 The role combines healthcare marketing knowledge, product and solution design, agentic engineering and enterprise technology leadership. The FDE partners with architecture, data, Adobe, security and delivery teams to move validated prototypes toward safe, scalable production use.
 



 Primary Responsibilities:
 



 · Healthcare Marketing Partnership
 



 o Work directly with marketing and marketing\-operations stakeholders to understand goals, current workflows, delays and decision points.
 



 o Apply healthcare payer, member and consumer context to campaign, audience, journey, offer, content and measurement decisions.
 



 o Account for privacy, consent, communication preferences, contact policies, approvals and human accountability.
 



 · Product \& Solution Design
 



 o Convert ambiguous business needs into a clear user problem, measurable outcome, constraints and priorities.
 



 o Design the customer journey, process, roles, handoffs, decisions, system touchpoints and feedback loop together.
 



 o Compare native platform capability, deterministic automation, agentic components and custom services using value, risk, cost and scale.
 



 o Build thin working prototypes, test with users and recommend whether to scale, change or stop.
 



 · Agentic Solution Engineering
 



 o Use ChatGPT or Claude effectively for discovery, analysis, design, coding, debugging, testing and correction \- not only content generation.
 



 o Build working agentic solutions using an API or SDK, structured outputs and at least one tool or enterprise interface.
 



 o Apply appropriate patterns for context, retrieval, function calling, MCP\-style integration, state, memory and error handling.
 



 o Define evaluation, guardrails, human approval, traceability, fallback, monitoring, latency and usage\-cost controls.
 



 · Enterprise Engineering \& Scale
 



 o Develop and review working software in a modern language such as Python, TypeScript, Java or C\#.
 



 o Design APIs, authentication, schemas, data pipelines, batch and event\-driven integrations with clear data\-quality controls.
 



 o Address identity, security, reliability, performance, scalability, cost, supportability and operational ownership.
 



 o Guide deployment, DevSecOps, observability, support and prototype\-to\-production decisions.
 



 · Collaboration \& Knowledge Transfer
 



 o Facilitate design reviews, communicate trade\-offs and influence business and technical ways of working.
 



 o Mentor engineers and work effectively with enterprise architects and platform specialists without replacing their accountabilities.
 



 o Document solution components, decisions, integrations, controls and the production transition path.
 



**Success Measures:** 




 · Shorter time from business need to validated solution evidence, measured against an agreed baseline.
 



 · Working prototypes meet defined functional, quality, safety and user\-acceptance criteria.
 



 · Solutions have a clear production path, operational ownership, controlled usage cost and stakeholder adoption.
 



**Required Qualifications:** 




 · Demonstrated healthcare payer, member or consumer marketing experience, including campaign lifecycle, audiences, journeys, communication controls and measurement.
 



 · Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders, framing ambiguous problems and shaping journey, process, operating\-model and solution trade\-offs.
 



 · Evidence of rapid prototyping, user testing and outcome\-based roadmap decisions.
 



 · Proficient use of ChatGPT or Claude as a builder, with clear methods for context management, verification and correction.
 



 · Hands\-on experience coding an agentic solution using tools or APIs, retrieval, function calling, MCP\-style integration, state and error handling.
 



 · Understanding of evaluation, guardrails, human control, monitoring, fallback and AgentOps practices.
 



 · Hands\-on software\-development and integration experience across APIs, data, events or batch patterns.
 



 · Ability to understand enterprise architecture and non\-functional requirements, mentor engineers and influence production\-scale design in a client\-facing environment.
 



**Preferred Qualifications:** 




 · Adobe MarTech solution literacy across AEP/RTCDP, AJO, CJA, audiences, journeys, publishing and activation channels.
 



 · Relevant certification, structured learning or portfolio evidence, plus deeper experience in Medicare, benefits, claims, retirement, offer management or regulated member communications.

title: Managing Consultant - Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Planning
description:
**Job Description**
 A Lead Consultant at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for managing mid\-to\-large\-size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. The ideal candidate will be a consummate professional who can thrive in an upbeat and innovative environment and collaborate with clients to deliver a state\-of\-the\-art solution. The individual will excel at delivering high quality service and cutting\-edge solutions to Argano clients in the Oracle community.
   

  

 The Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Planning \- Lead Consultant will focus on guiding and assisting clients through all phases of an Oracle Cloud Demand Management or Supply Planning implementation. The Functional Consultant is expected to have expertise in multiple Oracle Cloud SCP modules. The successful candidate will have completed three or more end\-to\-end implementations in Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Planning (SCP). This individual will identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles. They provide expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations. They are indirect mentors to other areas and grades. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively. Lead consultants work with security, data management, crisis management and should demonstrate exceptional knowledge of technology to deliver quality work that will drive customer satisfaction, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work well within a team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead mid to large size and complex consulting projects simultaneously.
* Using in\-depth knowledge of the Oracle Supply Chain Planning Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consults with clients to provide cost effective solutions to client business scenarios.
* Works collaboratively with project team and client employees to develop, test, and implement Oracle Clouds solutions.
* Refine customer requirements in detail, document and present to the client for approval
* Identifies and applies creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles and problems.
* Analyze current systems and data to identify new requirements, recognizing the need for systems enhancements or modifications if necessary
* Develop unit test scripts and coordinate with the client to perform the User Acceptance Testing of the system enhancements or custom solutions
* Work with Oracle to resolve service requests
* Lead and direct the following phases of system life cycle:
+ Gather business requirements through business process workshops
+ Analysis, design, configure and development solutions for Oracle Supply Chain Planning applications.
+ Conference Room Pilots (CRP) and User Acceptance Testing
+ Go\-Live preparation and cut\-over support
+ Post\-production support

* Develop and implement long\-term client strategies.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients. Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Keep all parties informed about project progress, challenges, and changes.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, and technology requirements. Conduct thorough assessments to identify areas where technology can drive improvements and efficiencies.
* Provide expert advice on technology solutions and tools that can enhance the client's operations. Help clients make informed decisions about adopting and implementing new technologies.
* Collaborate with third\-party vendors and suppliers to source necessary hardware, software, or services. Negotiate contracts and agreements to secure the best terms for the client.
* Offer ongoing technical support to address any issues or concerns that arise after implementation.
* Continuously monitor the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provide recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications as needed.


**Education**
**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, , Engineering, etc.
* MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD.


**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years of experience as an Oracle functional consultant with 3\+ years of experience in implementing Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Planning applications
* Experience with one or more of the following modules:
+ Demand Management
+ Supply Planning
+ Sales \& Operations Planning
+ Replenishment Planning
+ Global Order Promising
+ Backlog Management
+ Production Scheduling

* Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit\-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilot / prototyping (CRP or PRT), perform functional configuration, and manage testing (BPT, IST, SIT, UAT etc.) of Cloud SCP solutions.
* Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements
* Ability to lead a team, work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Prior experience leading or managing projects.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills
* High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Ability to write functional specification based on user requirements.
* Senior enough to be able to independently handle client expectations.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Proficient with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Willingness to travel as needed.
* Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.


**Skill Requirements**
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Complex Project Management: Lead Consultants are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.
* Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.
* Mentorship and Coaching: Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid\-level consultants is a significant responsibility.
* Strategic Vision: Lead Consultants should contribute to the company’s strategic vision and decision\-making.
* Executive Presence: The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.


**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
   

  

 Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

title: BC Sector-Life Sciences-ED
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The GDS Forecasting COE Leader is a senior leadership role accountable for building, scaling, and running a Center of Excellence dedicated to commercial forecasting services for Life Sciences clients. The role sits at the intersection of consulting go\-to\-market growth, delivery, analytics capability\-building, and commercial performance. It owns the COE talent and methodology backbone and positions forecasting as a differentiated offering within the broader Life Sciences practice. Reporting to the Life Sciences GDS Leader, the role is the primary escalation point for client delivery quality and internal capability development.
   

  

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
**Go\-to\-Market**
* Partner with solution, account, and sector leaders to identify, shape, and pursue forecasting\-led opportunities across existing and prospective client accounts.
* Lead or co\-lead proposal development, including solution design, pricing strategy, and staffing plans for forecasting engagements and RFPs.
* Build reusable forecasting assets including accelerators, frameworks, demo models, and points of view to reduce proposal cycle time and improve win rates.
* Represent the COE in client pitches, oral presentations, and executive discussions.
* Track and report the COE sales pipeline, win/loss trends, revenue contribution, and forecast to Life Sciences leadership.
* Develop and publish thought leadership, benchmarking studies, and conference content to establish market credibility.
* Identify and evaluate strategic alliances with forecasting technology and data partners to strengthen the solution stack.


**Delivery**
* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of forecasting deliverables across COE\-supported engagements.
* Lead engagements spanning customized platform or solution development and forecasting managed services.
* Establish and enforce model validation, assumption documentation, MAPE/accuracy tracking, peer review, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Define and continuously refine forecasting methodologies, matching the approach to the business question and available data.
* Provide technical oversight over gross\-to\-net modeling, loss\-ofexclusivity impact, TRx/NBRx trends, market sizing, competitive dynamics, and related parameters.
* Manage engagement economics, including utilization, effort estimates, and margin performance.
* Build and mentor a multi\-tiered team from analysts through senior managers, balancing pharmaceutical commercial expertise and analytics capability.
* Institutionalize lessons learned, client feedback, and forecast\-accuracy post\-mortems into refreshed playbooks and training.
* Guide adoption of forecasting platforms and tools, including AI\-first and agentic forecasting architectures where relevant.
* Act as the escalation point for at\-risk engagements and resolve delivery, staffing, or client relationship issues.


**Analytical/Decision Making** 
**Responsibilities**
* Determine the appropriate forecasting methodology, model architecture, data sources, validation approach, and governance level for complex client needs.
* Prioritize investments across talent, assets, platforms, alliances, and adjacent capabilities based on pipeline, scalability, and expected value.
* Balance growth, quality, utilization, margin, and talent sustainability across the COE portfolio.
* Make senior interventions on at\-risk engagements and decide when models, assumptions, staffing, or delivery plans require correction.
* Translate quantitative model outputs and uncertainty into clear commercial decisions and executive narratives.


**Education \& Experience**
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Statistics, Economics, Life Sciences, or a related field from a reputed institution; an advanced quantitative degree is a plus.
* 14\+ years of overall experience, including at least 8\-10 years in pharmaceutical or Life Sciences commercial forecasting.
* Experience in a top\-tier consulting firm, pharmaceutical commercial analytics function, or specialized forecasting firm is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a COE, practice area, or specialized delivery team, including P\&L or revenue accountability.
* Proven client\-facing delivery leadership across complex, multi\-market forecasting engagements.
* Experience managing large, distributed teams across onshore\-offshore delivery models.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Deep expertise in pharmaceutical commercial forecasting, including MAPE, gross\-to\-net, loss of exclusivity, TRx/NBRx, market share dynamics, and epidemiology\- and analogue\-based methods.
* Strong familiarity with pharmaceutical data platforms and datasets, including IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health, claims, and EHR data.
* Proficiency in Excel modeling, R, Python, and forecasting\-specific platforms; familiarity with AI/ML forecasting and agentic AI applications is highly desirable.
* Strong business development capability across proposal writing, client pitching, pricing, and senior relationship management.
* Proven people leadership across team building, performance management, mentoring, and capability development.
* Executive presence and the ability to translate complex quantitative outputs into clear business narratives.
* Understanding of the broader Life Sciences commercial ecosystem, including market access, patient engagement, and competitive intelligence.
* Strong governance and risk orientation, with attention to model accuracy, documentation rigor, and audit readiness.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior – School Partnerships
description:
Senior – School Partnerships
 



  





 Company: Dreamtime Learning
 



 Location: Hyderabad, India \| Travel across India as required
 



 Experience: 5\+ years in the K\-12 / School Education ecosystem
 



 Working Days: Monday–Saturday
 



 Laptop: Mandatory
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior – School Partnerships professional who understands the Indian school ecosystem and can build trusted relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, academic heads and education leaders.
 



  





 This is a consultative business development and sales role. The successful candidate will combine education expertise, relationship\-building, storytelling and commercial ability to engage schools, understand their needs and create opportunities for meaningful AI\-led transformation.
 



  





 We are looking for people who can tell a compelling story, influence senior stakeholders and convert conversations into partnerships.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Build School Partnerships
 



  





 \* Build and maintain strong relationships with school owners, trustees, principals and academic leaders.
 



 \* Develop a high\-quality network of schools across India.
 



 \* Identify and qualify new institutional opportunities.
 



 \* Build relationships from initial introduction through engagement, negotiation and closure.
 



 \* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and education institutions.
 



  





 Consultative Sales \& Business Development
 



  





 \* Understand the academic, operational and strategic challenges faced by schools.
 



 \* Identify opportunities where Dreamtime Learning can create meaningful value.
 



 \* Lead discovery conversations, presentations, workshops and demonstrations.
 



 \* Convert school challenges into compelling business and education propositions.
 



 \* Manage the sales cycle from prospecting → discovery → presentation → proposal → negotiation → closure.
 



 \* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
 



 \* Achieve agreed monthly and quarterly business development and revenue targets.
 



  





 Storytelling \& Stakeholder Engagement
 



  





 \* Present ideas around the future of education, AI and school transformation in a simple, compelling and relatable way.
 



 \* Be an engaging storyteller who can make senior education stakeholders understand why change is necessary and what is possible.
 



 \* Adapt communication to different audiences, from teachers and academic heads to principals, trustees and school owners.
 



 \* Conduct engaging workshops and leadership conversations.
 



 \* Represent Dreamtime Learning at principal forums, Sahodaya circles, education conclaves, conferences and industry events.
 



  





 Market Development
 



  





 \* Generate new opportunities through networking, referrals, events and existing relationships.
 



 \* Expand the school’s institutional network across assigned territories.
 



 \* Develop relationships with education communities, associations and influential stakeholders.
 



 \* Track market trends, competitor activity and changing school priorities.
 



 \* Identify new markets and partnership opportunities.
 



  





 Voice of the School
 



  





 \* Understand the real needs and challenges of schools.
 



 \* Capture market feedback and share insights with Academic, Product, Marketing and Leadership teams.
 



 \* Help shape how Dreamtime Learning communicates its value to schools.
 



 \* Identify emerging needs that can influence future offerings and engagement strategies.
 



  





 Key Result Indicators (KRIs)
 



  





 Performance will be measured across commercial growth, relationship development and school engagement.
 



  





 Commercial KRIs
 



  





 \* Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue / business targets.
 



 \* Number and value of qualified opportunities generated.
 



 \* Sales pipeline development and pipeline coverage.
 



 \* Number of school meetings and qualified stakeholder conversations.
 



 \* Presentation and demonstration\-to\-opportunity conversion.
 



 \* Proposal\-to\-closure conversion rate.
 



 \* Number of new institutional partnerships closed.
 



 \* Revenue generated from new and existing partnerships.
 



  





 Relationship KRIs
 



  





 \* Growth and quality of the school network.
 



 \* Number of senior\-level relationships established.
 



 \* Engagement with school owners, trustees, principals and academic heads.
 



 \* Referrals and opportunities generated through existing relationships.
 



 \* Participation and engagement in key education forums and networks.
 



  





 Engagement \& Adoption KRIs
 



  





 \* Workshops and school leadership sessions conducted.
 



 \* Quality of stakeholder engagement.
 



 \* Successful transition of partnerships from sales to implementation.
 



 \* Expansion opportunities within existing school relationships.
 



 \* Partner satisfaction and relationship health.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for someone who combines education credibility, storytelling ability and commercial drive.
 



  





 Essential
 



  





 \* 5\+ years of experience in the K\-12 ecosystem — EdTech, publishing, curriculum, school leadership, education services, technology or related sectors.
 



 \* Strong understanding of the Indian school ecosystem.
 



 \* Existing relationships with school owners, principals, trustees or academic leaders will be highly valued.
 



 \* Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
 



 \* Strong consultative selling and business development capability.
 



 \* Confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
 



 \* Ability to understand needs, influence decisions and close opportunities.
 



 \* Good understanding of pedagogy, curriculum, school operations and technology adoption.
 



 \* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
 



 \* Strong digital awareness and willingness to learn about AI and emerging technologies.
 



 \* Laptop mandatory.
 



  





 The Person We Are Looking For
 



  





 You could be an education professional, curriculum leader, EdTech professional, school solutions specialist, consultant, institutional sales professional or school leader.
 



  





 More importantly, you are:
 



  





 A Storyteller
 



 You can take an idea and make people see its possibility.
 



  





 A Relationship Builder
 



 People trust you and are willing to open doors for you.
 



  





 A Consultative Seller
 



 You listen first, understand the problem and then create the right proposition.
 



  





 A Commercial Thinker
 



 You understand that relationships must ultimately translate into opportunities, partnerships and revenue.
 



  





 An Education Insider
 



 You understand how schools operate, how decisions are made and what matters to education leaders.
 



  





 An AI \& Innovation Enthusiast
 



 You are curious about how AI and emerging technologies can reshape education and can communicate these possibilities to non\-technical audiences.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 The successful person will become a trusted education advisor and a strong commercial representative of Dreamtime Learning — someone who can open doors, create meaningful conversations, build conviction, and ultimately turn those relationships into successful school partnerships.
 



  





 If you can build the relationship, tell the story, create the opportunity and close the partnership — we want to hear from you.
